Tvoje projekty budú patriť medzi tie najzaujímavejšie na trhu – zamerané primárne na robotizáciu a automatizáciu v oblasti logistiky. Vyvíjame a integrujeme technológie, ktoré kombinujú softvér a hardvér, čím meníme spôsob, akým fungujú moderné sklady. Čo všetko budeš mať ako PM pod palcom? Náš tím tvoria programátori, zložený z Frontend-istov, Backend-istov, SQL špecialistov, Appkových developerov (Android, iOS). Celkovo sa venujeme: .Net Core 3.1, MSSQL, ASP.NET, C-Sharp, Kotlin, Swift, ReactJS, TypeScript, Cache. Čo vás u nás čaká? Navrhujete a optimalizujete riešenia v ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web Forms. Tvoríte unit testy, udržiavate kvalitu zdrojového kódu. Konzultujete a pripomienkujte postupy, návrhy riešenia a implementáciu s aplikačným architektom. Veľkou výhodou je MS SQL. Čo sa našim kolegom u nás páči? Nie sme korporát a ani malá firma – sme niečo medzi : ). Sme najväčšia súkromná zdravotná poisťovňa, ktorá je lídrom v inováciách. Ste v tíme šikovných kolegov a kolegýň, ktorí vás budú podporovať a učiť vás nové veci, ktoré vám pomôžu naštartovať vašu kariéru v IT-čkovom svete. Miesto výkonu práce: väčšina nášho tímu sedí na Moldavskej v Košiciach, ale pár kolegov nájdete aj v Bratislave na Einsteinovej v Digital parku, odkiaľ máte blízko do Auparku, centra a rovno aj na diaľnicu, von z mesta. If you are prepared to join a world-class team and grow fast, this is the right opportunity for you! Your job will involve working on prototype projects - on something, that no one has ever done before. You will make sure that telcos, data centers, or ISPs stay up-to-date on latest technologies and in the end, contribute to a faster, more interconnected world. You might also end up contributing to open-source projects and upholding to principles of open coding and development. How high can you climb? In our company, career growth is available for everybody willing to constantly improve himself. Crucially, this role involves active collaboration with our Security Operations (SecOps) team and participation in an on-call rotation to address urgent security matters.  Working within our SAFe framework, you will define robust processes, manage platform operations, implement effective controls, coordinate patch deployment, and provide essential expertise during security events across our diverse international infrastructure. Platform Operations: Oversee the configuration, operation, maintenance, and optimization of VP platforms (scanners, patch management systems). Explore integration points for CTI and SecOps tooling (SIEM, SOAR). Control Design & Monitoring: Design, implement, and monitor the effectiveness of security controls related to V&P Support internal and external audits. Patch Deployment Strategy & Coordination: Develop and manage patch deployment strategies, coordinate activities across diverse systems, use CTI to influence emergency patching, and manage the exception process. SAFe Agile Engagement: Actively participate in SAFe ceremonies as the V&P/applied CTI SME. Collaborate with ARTs, Product Owners, and System Architects. Technical Guidance&Continuous Improvement: Provide expert advice on remediation; stay abreast of vulnerabilities, threats (via CTI), and methodologies; drive improvements and automation. Proven experience as an SME in the V&P domain. Solid understanding and practical application of Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) within vulnerability management. In-depth knowledge of V&P tools (scanners, patch management systems). Strong understanding of OS (Windows, Linux), networking, CVSS, common vulnerabilities. Experience defining and managing V&P processes and controls. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills under pressure. You will lead the BAU and continuous improvement of the Foundry-based Data Products Platform, balancing architecture stewardship with agile product ownership. Your responsibilities cover data modeling, platform governance, performance optimization, and enablement. At the same time, you will act as an Asset Management Domain Data Architect, owning and evolving Asset Management data architecture further. Curious to learn more? Let’s dive in! Your key responsibilities: As a Product Owner •	Own the roadmap, backlog, and priorities for platform stability, security, and feature evolution •	Ensure the platform remains aligned with architectural best practices and enterprise standards •	Balance operational reliability (incident management, monitoring, runbooks) with strategic development (enhancements, automation, and innovation) •	Prioritize improvements that deliver sustainable business value, such as reusability, maintainability, and governance automation •	Monitor and optimize platform performance, ensuring critical SLAs (e.g., KEP, KWP) are consistently met •	Coordinate closely with use-case oriented squads to ensure platform scalability, enablement, and smooth onboarding of new use cases •	Develop and maintain reusable components, templates, and patterns to accelerate delivery of new data solutions. •	Create and share best-practice documentation, onboarding materials, and training to uplift data engineering maturity across the organization As an AM Data Architect •	Define and maintain data models (structured and unstructured) across the Asset Management landscape (AMADM, Markit EDM, and related schemas) •	Govern schema, metadata, and lineage standards across Foundry; review and approve model changes for consistency and compliance •	Define integration patterns, data flow design, and architectural guidelines for cross-domain interoperability •	Ensure all changes adhere to data governance principles, including classification, retention, and metadata completeness •	Collaborate with other teams to define and evolve data architecture blueprints, governance frameworks, and performance guidelines •	Provide architectural oversight for Foundry and other use cases, ensuring solutions adhere to AM data architecture principles and Swiss Re standards •	Represent the squad in architecture and data governance forums, advocating for standardization, interoperability, and continuous improvement About the Team At the heart of Data & Tech Asset Management, Platform Excellence team ensures that Foundry Data Products use-cases run securely, efficiently and in line with enterprise data architecture principles. We ensure that clients get best support with data questions or platform expansion requests. Our mission is simple but essential: Keep platform stable, performance and compliant – while empowering our clients to innovate safely and quickly. As part of Swiss Re's Asset Management Digital & Tech organization, we work in a scaled agile model with a shared leadership team and broadly aligned autonomy for our squads. We are located across the globe but share the same values of passion, openness, respect, humility, and curiosity in our team. We strive to improve the quality of our work for our customers every day. As a matter of trust, we give you a high degree of flexibility which matches your independent working style. Is this for you? Then we want to get to know you! You're equally comfortable discussing schema normalization as you are defining roadmap priorities or handling production incidents. Essentials: •	Proven track record as Data Architect, Data Product Owner, or Platform Owner in a data-intensive environment •	Deep expertise in data modeling, data governance, ETL, and performance optimization •	Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry (Object Sets, Ontologies, Code Workbooks, Contour) •	Technical fluency in Python, SQL, and PySpark •	Experience managing agile backlogs and balancing BAU with strategic initiatives •	Strong understanding of security, access control, and compliance in enterprise data platforms •	Excellent communication skills — able to translate between technical and business perspectives Nice to haves: •	Familiarity with Stargate, Databricks, or MSBI ecosystems •	Knowledge of asset management data domains and operational data flows •	Experience defining data platform architecture patterns or DevSecOps automation •	Cloud platform understanding (Azure, AWS) Take a next step in your career and hit APPLY button. Robíme všetko pre to, aby sme boli najlepšia zdravotná poisťovňa na slovenskom trhu a mali čoraz viac spokojných poistencov. To sa týka aj poskytovania kvalitných služieb a produktov. Do akého tímu budete patriť? Budete patriť do tímu CX, v ktorom pracujú UX dizajnéri, UI dizajnéri a UX writerky. Je nás spolu 13 – 9 žien a 4 muži. Za jeden z najväčších plusov svojej práce označujú dizajnéri pohodovú atmosféru v tíme a ochotu všetkých členov navzájom si pomáhať. Nehrozí vám rutina, budete súčasťou tímu nadšencov pre inovácie a nové projekty. Pracuje na striedačku z officu a z domu, podľa toho ako to komu vyhovuje. Aspoň raz za týždeň sa stretneme v office a ideme spolu na obed pokecať o tom, ako sa máme pracovne aj nepracovne, aké knihy práve čítame, čo dobrého sme videli na Netflixe a TikToku a čo vyviedli naše mačky, psy a deti :-). Čo vás u nás čaká? Hľadáme UX dizajnéra/ku a výskumníka/čku, ktorá/ý má za sebou už viaceré projekty pre rôznych klientov, dokáže samostatne viesť projekty a neúnavne vysvetľovať hodnotu dizajnu. Podieľanie sa  na tvorbe a rozvoji produktov a služieb, napríklad našej mobilnej aplikácie, ktorá je dlhodobo najlepšie hodnotenou aplikáciou zdravotných poisťovní na Slovensku aj v ČR. Overovanie a rozvíjanie UX a dizajnu prostredníctvom výskumu a testovania – so zámerom pochopiť používateľov, vylepšiť použiteľnosť digitálnych produktov a biznisové metriky. Facilitácia dizajnových šprintov, hľadanie dizajnových riešení podľa výsledkov výskumu, rozvíjanie persón a zákazníckych ciest, dohliadanie na zákaznícku skúsenosť naprieč všetkými kanálmi. Obhajovanie princípov design thinkingu a CX, vzdelávanie a zapájanie stakeholderov do procesu vývoja produktov Navrhovanie wireframov vo Figme a účasť na sparingoch s UI dizajnérmi, UX writermi, developermi, produktovými a biznisovými vlastníkmi. Práca s nástrojmi Hotjar a Google Analytics. Čo by ste mali ovládať? Ak ste detailista so silnou empatiu, analytickými schopnosťami, logickým myslením a chuťou neustále sa vzdelávať, bude sa Vám u nás páčiť. Kľúčovým predpokladom je skúsenosť s prieskumom, znalosť kvantitatívnych aj kvalitatívnych metód a nástrojov UX výskumu. Dokážete v používateľských dátach vidieť to, čo iní nie a váš projekt nikdy nekončí odovzdávkou, ale pokračuje ďalším meraním. Dôležité je, aby ste boli ochotná/ý učiť sa a pracovať na sebe a naši UX dizajnéri vám pomôžu s onboardingom. Máte veľa energie a kopec nápadov. Ste spoľahlivá/ý, ochotná/ý prijímať nové výzvy a feedback. Čo sa našim kolegom u nás páči? Káva zadarmo, služobný mobil a MacBook podľa nás nie sú pracovné benefity, ale samozrejmosť. Preto sa môžete tešiť napríklad na finančné bonusy, kurzy a konferencie podľa svojho výberu, bežecké tréningy, Multisport kartu, kratšie piatky. psychoterapiu zdarma, linku psychologickej a právnej pomoci a mnoho ďalších výhod. Nehodíme vás do vody, ale budeme vám pomáhať naskočiť na projekty a cítiť sa v tíme od začiatku fajn. Prácu zvládame odkiaľkoľvek. Každý zamestnanec môže pracovať v režime 50% home office a 50% office. Ak preferujete častejšiu prácu z domu, režim home office si po dohode s manažérom môžete navýšiť až do 100%. Vaše budúce kolegyne a kolegovia označujú za jeden z najväčších plusov svojej práce príjemnú atmosféru v tíme a ochotu všetkých členov navzájom si pomáhať. Teambuildingy prebiehajú v pracovnej dobe a sú dobrovoľné, pretože aj keď sme spolu radi, chápeme, že ľudia potrebujú voľný čas pre seba. Radi občas vypneme a zregenerujeme svoje sily na našich spoločných dobrovoľných akciách ako sú športové hry, vianočné večierky, grilovačky, husaciny, alebo teambuildingy. Čo by vás ešte mohlo zaujímať? Miesto výkonu práce: sedíme na Einsteinovej v Digital Parku, odkiaľ máte blízko do Auparku, centra či rovno na diaľnicu von z mesta. Priestor na realizáciu a experimentovanie: Dostaneš možnosť navrhovať a implementovať vlastné nápady v oblasti AI a automatizácie. Strmá krivku učenia: Garantujeme ti prístup k najnovším technológiám, interným aj externým školeniam, konferenciám a podporu skúsených kolegov. Super kolektív a firemnú kultúru: Sme partia ľudí, ktorí si navzájom pomáhajú, hovoria veci na rovinu a ťahajú za jeden povraz. Fungujeme systematicky podľa EOS. As the Information Protection Specialist, you'll own the technical solutions to protect Swiss Re's sensitive data, monitor alerts related to data leakage, conduct regular analyses and monitor patterns to identify insider threats. What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup, perfectly balancing work from home and the office premises. We also collaborate in a flexible working environment, providing you with a compelling degree of autonomy to decide how, when and where to carry out your tasks. We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder. Dobrý pocit z toho, že spolu aktívne, systematicky a zmysluplne meníme nielen našu poisťovňu, ale aj celé zdravotníctvo, budete mať každý deň. Robíme všetko preto, aby sme boli v očiach verejnosti najlepšia zdravotná poisťovňa na slovenskom trhu a mali čoraz viac spokojných zamestnancov a poistencov. Ak chcete byť aj vy súčasťou modernej a stabilnej spoločnosti, ktorej oblasť inovácií a benefitov pre poistencov ako aj pre lekárov prináša pridanú hodnotu pre celý systém, pridajte sa k nám do Dôvery. Do akého tímu budete patriť? Naše IT je domovom pre už 200 odborníkov, ktorí sa venujú testovaniu, programovaniu a analýze. Tím testerov má viac ako 20 členov a je rozdelený podľa úrovne skúseností na juniorov, mediorov a seniorov, čo vytvára priestor na výmenu znalostí a profesionálny rast. Naša základňa sa nachádza v Košiciach, kde nás nájdete v prostredí, v ktorom si rozumieme nielen s technológiami, ale aj medzi sebou. Testujeme naše aplikácie elektronickej pobočky pre poistencov, poskytovateľov zdravotnej starostlivosti, platiteľov poistného, tiež mobilnú aplikáciu a rôzne interné aplikácie, ktoré vyvíjame agilne. Ak vás baví nachádzať chyby tam, kde ich iní nevidia, a máte radi prácu, ktorá má význam, potom do nášho tímu skvele zapadnete. Čo Vás u nás čaká? Pomáhate tímu tvoriť testovacie scenáre, podľa biznis požiadaviek a scenárov použitia. Manuálne testujete webovú aplikáciu (aj na základe testovacích scenárov) počas ich implementácie. Odhaľujete, zaznamenávate a reportujete zistené chyby. Komunikujete s biznis vlastníkmi a používateľmi. Pomáhate riešiť problémy z prevádzky. Zodpovedáte za tvorbu evidencie k incidentom. Čo by ste mali ovládať? Máte základnú znalosť manuálneho testovania. Základná znalosť v tvorbe a exekúcií testovacích scenárov (Xray alebo podobný nástroj) je veľkou výhodou. Máte znalosť v tvorbe SQL dotazov nad relačnými databázami (výbery dát a ich modifikácia v tabuľkách). Akékoľvek praktické skúsenosti s testovaním a programovaním sú viac než vítané. Čo sa našim kolegom u nás páči? Nie sme korporát a ani malá firma – sme niečo medzi :). Sme najväčšia súkromná zdravotná poisťovňa, ktorá je lídrom v inováciách. U nás máte príležitosť pre svoj rozvoj a osobný rast. Ste v tíme šikovných kolegov/-ýň, ktorí vás budú podporovať a učiť vás nové veci, ktoré vám pomôžu naštartovať vašu kariéru v IT-čkovom svete. Máte možnosť získať praktické skúsenosti s modernými trendami a technológiami v oblasti IT. A navyše, proaktivita a šikovnosť sa u nás cení. Veľa našich šikovných kolegov u nás má možnosť ostať aj po skončení VŠ štúdia. Ste súčasťou tímu, a preto sa aj vy môžete s nami vzdelávať na našich interných rozvojových popoludniach. Radi občas vypneme a zregenerujeme svoje sily na našich spoločných akciách. Čo by Vás ešte mohlo zaujímať? Miesto výkonu práce: prevažná časť nášho interného IT-čka sedí v Košiciach, v modernom biznis centre na Moldavskej, ale máme kolegov aj na našej centrále v Bratislave, na Einsteinovej v Digital parku, odkiaľ máte blízko do Auparku, centra a rovno aj na diaľnicu, von z mesta. Spolupráca: hľadáme kolegu/kolegyňu na dohodu o brigádnickej práci študenta. Onboarding: Začína od momentu, kedy zareagujete na inzerát. A ja vás budem sprevádzať vaším pôsobením v Dôvere od prvého kontaktu. Kedykoľvek sa môžete na mňa obrátiť. Gryphon chráni zariadenia prostredníctvom pokročilých techník detekcie a obrany voči škodlivému kódu a využíva ho čoraz viac klientov z rôznych sektorov. Našim cieľom nie je nič menej, ako pomôcť používateľom držať ransomware na dištanc a pomôcť s incident responsom. Chceme sa pomocou Gryphona zbaviť príjmov z našich Incident Response činností spojených s vydieračským malware!​ Na čom to budeš pracovať? Pracovať budeš na agentskej časti nášho riešenia. Agenti slúžia na zber dát, vyhodnocovanie pravidiel, prijímanie príkazov zo servera a ovládanie zariadení. Všetko čo sa deje na endpointoch je potom analyzované a spracované v našej webovej službe. Agent funguje na všetkých vrstvách operačného systému od user-modu po kernel-mode, aby mal možnosť detekovať a blokovať všetky hrozby. Väčšina agenta beží v user-mode a je písaná v modernom C++ , no na komplexnú ochranu systému je potrebný aj kernel-mode kód s obmedzenými možnosťami C++. Pošli nám svoj životopis (kariera@egroup.sk) a napíš pár slov o tom, prečo ťa baví Linux. Radi ťa spoznáme pri káve v našej bratislavskej kancelárii. Vyhradzujeme si právo odpovedať iba kandidátom, ktorí budú pozvaní na pohovor. Vopred ďakujeme všetkým uchádzačom za prejavený záujem. So zaslaním životopisu súhlasíte so spracovaním osobných údajov. Údaje, ktoré nám poskytnete, starostlivo posúdime a spracujeme v súlade so zákonom o ochrane osobných údajov. Predpokladaný termín ukončenia výberového konania 30.11.2025 (ostáva ešte 27 dní) Požiadavky na zamestnanca Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním stredoškolské s maturitou nadstavbové/vyššie odborné vzdelanie študent vysokej školy vysokoškolské I. stupňa vysokoškolské II. stupňa vysokoškolské III. stupňa Vzdelanie v odbore technické zameranie, IT Jazykové znalosti Anglický jazyk - Stredne pokročilý (B2) Vodičský preukaz B Prax na pozícii/v oblasti IT Pozícia je vhodná pre absolventa Áno Osobnostné predpoklady a zručnosti Čo by si mal vedieť alebo mať Základnú znalosť Linux systémov (ideálne RHEL, CentOS alebo Ubuntu) Chuť učiť sa nové veci a zlepšovať sa v oblasti IT infraštruktúry Základy sieťových konceptov, virtualizácie a skriptovania (bash, python – výhoda) Zodpovedný prístup, tímového ducha a chuť pracovať na sebe Ak máš skúsenosti s nástrojmi ako Ansible, Docker, OpenShift , budeme nadšení — ak nie, naučíme ťa ich. ️Tvoj ďalší rozvoj bude smerovať do oblasti kontajnerizácie a platformy OpenShift , takže ak ťa láka svet DevOps a moderných infraštruktúr, toto je ideálne miesto, kde začať. Inzerujúca spoločnosť Stručná charakteristika spoločnosti Sme eGroup Solutions – slovenská IT spoločnosť s viac ako 15-ročnou históriou. Budujeme a spravujeme moderné IT infraštruktúry, cloudujeme, automatizujeme a prinášame riešenia pre veľkých aj menších zákazníkov. Sme renomovaným dodávateľom technologicky orientovaných riešení a komplexných služieb IT, zameriavame sa na realizáciu IT projektov a podporu prevádzky IT. Našich 600+ vývojárov však hovorí, že sme technologická spoločnosť s bankovou licenciou. Prinášame nové funkcie do interných aplikácií, vyvíjame tabletové riešenia, AI nástroje, bezpečnostné systémy a ďalšie moderné IT riešenia. A ešte taká maličkosť: Sme najväčší. Pre teba to znamená vyladené procesy, špičkové technológie a nekonečno možností rastu. Uznávame odvahu a chuť experimentovať. Predovšetkým ale budujeme finančnú budúcnosť Slovenska, pretože jednoducho chceme, aby sa tu žilo dobre. Ver tomu, že to máme v hlave upratané. Aj v kóde a dátach. Koho hľadáme? Skúseného IT analytika alebo analytičku. Potrebujeme niekoho, kto dokáže prepojiť biznis potreby s modernými IT riešeniami, chápe architektúru systémov, databáz a API, dokáže analyzovať dáta a integračné rozhrania a zároveň prichádza s návrhmi na zlepšenie. Čomu sa budeš venovať: Analýza biznisových potrieb a ich preklad do funkčných a technických požiadaviek Spolupráca na tvorbe technického dizajnu a vypracovaní funkčných špecifikácií Návrh a správa integračných rozhraní medzi komponentmi IT infraštruktúry (SOAP/REST) Podpora vývojárov a spolupráca na mikroservisnej architektúre Implementácia a správa IAM riešení - Single Sign-On (SSO), federované identity, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, multifaktorová autentifikácia Orientácia v kryptografii na aplikačnej úrovni: šifrovanie, digitálne podpisy, hashovanie Tvorba a udržiavanie dokumentácie v nástrojoch ako Confluence a JIRA Podpora testovania a produkčných verzií aplikácií Komunikácia a koordinácia s internými oddeleniami aj externými dodávateľmi Čo u nás nečakaj: Vyťukávačky v závetrí zaprášenej korporácie Schvaľovanie inovácií cez 12 úrovní Že výsledok svojej práce uvidíš tak za 8 rokov (ak vôbec) Že ti niekto bude stáť za chrbtom a hovoriť ti, ako a čo presne máš robiť Kravaty, kostýmčeky & nudu, lebo veď sme banka Že najnovší výkvet techniky bude Excel 97 a fax Čo treba mať v tech stacku: Orientácia v architektúre systémov, API, databázach a integračných rozhraniach (SOAP/REST) Skúsenosti s mikroservisovou architektúrou Znalosť IAM (SSO, federované identity, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, MFA) Orientácia v kryptografii na aplikačnej úrovni (šifrovanie, digitálne podpisy, hashovanie) Práca s cloudovými technológiami: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud výhodou Python, stream/NoSQL (Spark, Kafka) Angličtina na úrovni B2 Čo ti za to dáme: Slušný plat. Aj ten trinásty, a k tomu ročný bonus. Extra effort = extra odmena. Na jedlo ti prispejeme až 8 € denne. Aj počas dovolenky. Lebo hladný analytik je nahnevaný analytik. Príspevok do 3. piliera 840 € ročne. 5 dní dovolenky navyše. Lucky time, keď potrebuješ viac než dovolenku. Voľno aj na výročie Nežnej revolúcie, pretože si myslíme, že tento deň treba sláviť. Ďalšie voľné dni pri špeciálnych príležitostiach, ako napríklad narodenie dieťaťa. Spoločný úspech znamená zisk aj pre teba, pretože si akcionár alebo akcionárka ERSTE. Multisport alebo UpBalansea karta. Ideš do toho? Pošli nám životopis aj motivačný list. Ozve sa ti Dominika z People & Culture oddelenia, prebehne krátky telefonický rozhovor s doplňujúcimi otázkami, potom nasleduje online technické kolo s tvojou IT analytickou dvojičkou z tímu a nakoniec osobné stretnutie s ďalšími členmi tímu. Hotovo, máš notebook a snažíš sa zapamätať si mená kolegov. Dobré CV sa u nás nestratia - aj z pôvodne neúspešného kandidáta sa môže stať náš úspešný kolega či kolegyňa. Preto nám daj o sebe vedieť! :) Budúcnosť je tvoja v Slovenskej sporiteľni! Kontaktné údaje: Mgr.  Dominika Majerčáková Slovenská sporiteľňa, a.s. title: Manager Global HR IT Operations
description: Manager Global HR IT Operations Adient Slovakia s.r.o. Place of work Adient Slovakia s.r.o., Bratislava Business Center, Štúrova, Bratislava, Slovakia (Job with occasional home office) Contract type full-time Wage (gross) 4 000 EUR/month Final salary can be higher than the starting minimum written in the advert Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Manager Global HRIT Operations What can you expect? Lead the end-to-end management of our Workday platform—covering demand intake, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations—within a global HR technology landscape. Serve as the primary technology partner to HR and IT leaders, translating business needs into scalable, secure, and cost-effective Workday solutions using native capabilities (e.g., integrations, reporting, security, and configuration). Direct onshore and offshore support and development teams to provide reliable, follow-the-sun coverage across regions and time zones; own incident, problem, and change processes to safeguard stability and performance. Establish and enforce SOX-compliant controls, release management, and documentation standards; ensure audit readiness and operational resilience. Drive a continuous-improvement agenda that enhances user experience, reduces risk, and accelerates value delivery from Workday across the enterprise. Adient (NYSE: ADNT) is a global leader in automotive seating. With 70,000+ employees in 29 countries, Adient operates more than 200 manufacturing/assembly plants worldwide. We produce and deliver automotive seating for all major OEMs. From complete seating systems to individual foam, trim and metal components, our expertise spans every step of the automotive seat-making process. Our integrated, in-house skills allow us to take our products from research and design to engineering and manufacturing — and into millions of vehicles every year. For more information, visit www.adient.com. At Adient, we are proud to offer hybrid working to our employees, which involves being able to work remotely for up to 3 days per week based on the agreement within specific department. What will your responsibilities be? •	Partner with HR leadership and stakeholders to build strong relationships, understand business priorities, and translate them into effective Workday solutions. •	Gather, analyze, and validate business requirements, ensuring alignment with global standards while balancing regional and local needs. •	Lead the global Workday support and development function, including demand intake, solution design, configuration, integrations, reporting, and security. •	Manage a portfolio of initiatives and operational activities, establishing prioritization and resource allocation processes to maximize value delivery. •	Oversee onshore and offshore teams, ensuring effective collaboration, knowledge sharing, and follow-the-sun support coverage. •	Drive Workday development best practices, including configuration management, testing, and deployment processes that meet quality, schedule, and budget expectations. •	Own governance for change management, including submission, prioritization, and approval of enhancements, fixes, and improvements. •	Ensure compliance with SOX, data privacy, and audit requirements, maintaining documentation and controls for all system changes. •	Monitor and optimize system performance and cost-effectiveness, implementing improvements to reduce total cost of ownership and enhance user experience. •	Define and enforce service level agreements (SLAs) for application support, ensuring high availability, reliability, and minimal disruption to business operations. •	Manage team performance and development, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and succession planning for HRIT resources. •	Develop and manage budgets for projects, operations, and vendor services, ensuring financial accountability and cost optimization. •	Champion continuous improvement and innovation, leveraging Workday capabilities to deliver scalable, secure, and future-ready HR technology solutions. Which qualifications are we looking for in potential employees? •	Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline required. •	MBA or Master’s degree preferred. •	Minimum 12 years of technical/functional experience in applications development or HR technology. •	At least 8 years in a leadership role managing technical teams, with proven ability to deliver complex technology projects on time and within budget. •	Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing technical and functional team members. •	Extensive experience leading Workday integrations and development, including Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, WECI, and related technologies (XML, XSLT, REST/SOAP APIs). •	Hands-on experience with Workday Integration Cloud Connect for leveraging prebuilt connectors and orchestrating end-to-end integrations. •	Strong knowledge of Workday Orchestrate for building and automating workflows across Workday and third-party systems using low-code/no-code tools, real-time event-driven triggers, and governance controls. •	Familiarity with Workday Extend and its role in enabling custom orchestration and integration with external systems. •	Proven ability to lead global, onshore/offshore teams in a matrixed, multinational environment. •	Strong organizational and resource management skills, including budgeting and vendor management. •	Ability to influence and collaborate across functions and cultures. •	Deep understanding of SOX compliance, data privacy regulations, and audit requirements. •	Experience implementing governance frameworks for change management and release processes. •	Strong background in project management, including scope control, risk mitigation, and resource planning. •	Thorough understanding of application development methodologies, standards, and best practices. •	Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including those for whom English is a second language. •	Customer-focused mindset with a track record of delivering high-quality, user-centric solutions. Which benefits do we offer? •	Base monthly salary starting from 4000 EUR gross. Our salary is fair and competitive and can be higher than the starting minimum in the advert •	13th salary •	Language and proficiency courses •	Meal vouchers - 7€ (fully paid by employer) •	Flexible working hours, possibility to work remotely including days from abroad •	Extra holiday entitlement •	Inclusive allowance scheme including Health support allowance, Jubilee allowance, Housing allowance •	Referral bonus •	Employee Assistance Program "Felix" •	Volunteer days •	Active life with colleagues, full of various sports activities •	Various CSR Activities •	Modern relax areas, play room •	Coffee and tea at the workplace Adient is committed to equal employment opportunity, diversity and inclusion in the workplace. As a true global company, our leaders and employees come from various cultures across the world. Our diversity is a source of inspiration enabling us to achieve our goals and build an inclusive company culture. We are looking forward to receiving your application including your salary expectations and your earliest availability date. If you have additional questions, please do not hesitate to contact Kristián Psotný on +421257271162. We are committed to Sustainability and are proud ambassador of Diversity Charter in Slovakia since 2017. Adient’s only business center worldwide is in Bratislava. Approximately 800 employees in Bratislava support the company’s business around the globe in finance, information technology, purchasing, sales, human resources, transport and logistics and project management. In Trencin, Adient operates the biggest automotive technology center across Slovakia. More than 400 employees there develop a wide range of highly innovative products for the cars of tomorrow. In Zilina, the company produces complete seat systems and automotive fabrics, in Lucenec foam components for seats as well as metal components for head restraints. title: Business Analyst PLM/Integrations
description: Business Analyst PLM/Integrations Adient Slovakia s.r.o. Place of work Adient Slovakia, s.r.o., Trenčín, Slovakia (Job with occasional home office) Contract type full-time Wage (gross) 2 000 EUR/month Final salary can be higher than the starting minimum written in the advert Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Business Analyst PLM/Integrations What can you expect? Adient (NYSE: ADNT) is a global leader in automotive seating. With 70,000+ employees in 29 countries, Adient operates more than 200 manufacturing/assembly plants worldwide. We produce and deliver automotive seating for all major OEMs. From complete seating systems to individual foam, trim and metal components, our expertise spans every step of the automotive seat-making process. Our integrated, in-house skills allow us to take our products from research and design to engineering and manufacturing — and into millions of vehicles every year. For more information, visit www.adient.com. At Adient, we are proud to offer hybrid working to our employees, which involves being able to work remotely for up to 2 days per week based on the agreement within specific department. What will your responsibilities be? •	Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with Engineering, PMO, Purchasing, Quality teams to understand their needs and priorities. •	Strategic Planning: Collaborate with business leaders to develop IT strategies that support business goals and drive innovation. •	Project Management: Oversee the delivery of IT projects, ensuring they meet business requirements, are delivered on time, and within budget. •	Service Management: Ensure IT services are aligned with business needs and are delivered with high quality and reliability. •	Change Management: Lead change management initiatives to ensure smooth adoption of new technologies and processes. •	Risk Management: Identify and mitigate risks associated with IT projects and services. •	Training: Training the business teams about the new tools and technologies •	Alignment to IT Goals: Promote the use of emerging technologies to drive business innovation and efficiency. Align with Adient IT Goals Which qualifications are we looking for in potential employees? •	A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Mechanical / Manufacturing Engineering or a related field. •	6+ Years of experience in a similar role. •	Working experience of Teamcenter RAC, AWC and other modules of Teamcenter such as Structure Manager, Query builder, Change Management •	Good understanding of Engineering Bill of Materials, precise & imprecise BOMs, TC data model  (e.g., relationships between the objects). •	Good understanding of interfaces and middleware such as eQube, Seeburger including data Mapping/transformation. •	Experience supporting integrations between Teamcenter and SAP, QAD, Mendix and custom applications using API’s, file transfer, TC Webservices. •	Proficient in working with data formats such as XML and JSON •	Should have experience in working on Azure DevOps or similar ALM tools for requirement / Bugs creation and tracking •	Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of interpreting complex datasets and visualizing information effectively. •	Technical Proficiency: Azure DevOps user level, Proficiency in Excel, MS Project, MS PPT, Agile Methodology •	Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written skills to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels and present findings in a clear and concise manner. •	Collaboration and Leadership: Ability to work in a team environment, facilitating communication and ensuring project goals are met collaboratively. Which benefits do we offer? •	Base monthly salary starting from 2000 Eur gross. Our salary is fair and competitive and can be higher than the starting minimum written in the advert. •	13th salary •	Additional holiday days based on seniority •	Meal vouchers - 7€ (fully paid by employer) •	Language courses, trainings •	Childbirth/Wedding allowance, Relocation support, Referral bonus, Blood donation allowance •	Coffee and tea at workplace, own canteen •	Employee wellbeing – massages at the workplace, sport activities; 7-10 days of fully paid sickness within a year, life insurance, vitamin voucher •	Employee Assistance Program "Felix" – psychological, financial and legal support •	Stable, long-term employment in strong international company with friendly working atmosphere •	Opportunity to collaborate on volunteering activities •	Flexible working time, Hybrid Work Model – combination of home office (including limited days of work from abroad) and work from the office •	Work on latest projects in automotive seats development Adient is committed to equal employment opportunity, diversity and inclusion in the workplace. As a true global company, our leaders and employees come from various cultures across the world. Our diversity is a source of inspiration enabling us to achieve our goals and build an inclusive company culture. We are looking forward to receiving your application including your salary expectations and your earliest availability date. If you have additional questions, please do not hesitate to contact Kristian Psotny on +421257271162. Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position Secondary with school-leaving examination Follow-up/Higher Professional Education University education (Bachelor's degree) University education (Master's degree) Postgraduate (Doctorate) Advertiser Brief description of the company Adient is the leading automotive seating supplier. With around 3000 employees and five locations in Slovakia, the company is one of the key employers in Slovakia’s automotive industry. We are committed to Sustainability and are proud ambassador of Diversity Charter in Slovakia since 2017. Adient’s only business center worldwide is in Bratislava. Approximately 800 employees in Bratislava support the company’s business around the globe in finance, information technology, purchasing, sales, human resources, transport and logistics and project management. In Trencin, Adient operates the biggest automotive technology center across Slovakia. More than 400 employees there develop a wide range of highly innovative products for the cars of tomorrow. In Zilina, the company produces complete seat systems and automotive fabrics, in Lucenec foam components for seats as well as metal components for head restraints. Adient is a global leader in automotive seating. With approximately 70 000 employees in 30 countries, Adient operates 200 manufacturing/assembly plants worldwide, we produce and deliver automotive seating for all vehicle classes and all major OEMs. From complete seating systems to individual components, our expertise spans every step of the automotive seat-making process. Our integrated, in-house skills allow us to take our products from research and design all the way to engineering and manufacturing – and into more than 20 million cars every year. title: BI Analyst - supply chain
description: PRIPOJTE SA K NÁM  EŠTE DNES A ZAČNITE BUDOVAŤ SVOJU KARIÉRU V MEDLINE! Spoločnosť Medline bola založená V roku 1910. Aktuálne s 28 000 zamestnancami po celom svete s obzvlášť silným zastúpením v Severnej Amerike a Európe, je poprednou svetovou zdravotníckou spoločnosťou.  V dnešnej dobe Medline vyrába a distribuuje viac ako 350 000 zdravotníckych výrobkov podporujúcich celú škálu starostlivosti, vrátane nemocníc, chirurgických centier, domácej starostlivosti, výskumných laboratórií a lekárskych ordinácií. Ponúkame komplexný sortiment produktov od rukavíc, masiek, pracovných plášťov cez vybavenie operačných sál, až po produkty starostlivosti o pacienta. BI Analyst - supply chain Malobielická 284/8 | Partizánske 958 04, Slovensko Náplň práce, zodpovednosti: Supply Chain BI Analyst for EU Department: Supply Chain Reports to: Supply Chain process Improvement Senior Manager Location: Partizanske (SK) About us: Medline is a leading provider of medical-surgical products and supply chain solutions, serving all points of care. Through a wide-ranging product portfolio, a robust supply chain network and modern clinical solutions, Medline helps healthcare providers (HCPs) improve their clinical, financial and operational outcomes. Headquartered in Northfield, Illinois, United States, the company employs more than 43,000 people worldwide and operates in more than 100 countries and territories. Outside the US, Medline International B.V. serves as the international headquarters and is located in the Netherlands (currently Arnhem; to be moved to Utrecht in 2025). To learn more about Medline’s operations in Europe, visit www.medline.eu. Purpose As BI Analyst you will play a key role to support the Supply Chain organization by implementing and maintaining,efficient well-designed data analytics solutions. You are expected to became an expert in the current Supply Chain data platform and contribute to building future solutions, while demonstrating strong team spirit and mindset of continuous improvement. Your scope will cover Supply Chain activities (Demand, Supply and Distribution for Purchased and manufactured Goods) to serving all Medline EU Product Divisions. How can you help us? * Define & Design: Identify gaps in our current BI solutions, prioritize improvements based on business value, and help design consistent, scalable data models across platforms. * Measure & Refine: Collect relevant data, define meaningful metrics, and collaborate with stakeholders to fine-tune requirements. * Analyze & Support: Investigate supply chain challenges, visualize data effectively, and support daily operations with impactful analysis. You’ll also assist IT in resolving BI-related incidents. * Implement & Innovate: Build and maintain dashboards and reports that monitor key supply chain activities. You’ll advocate for user-friendly solutions and propose new ideas to improve performance. * Control & Communicate: Standardize reporting practices, train users on new tools, and ensure clear communication across departments—from end users to executives. Are you a match? * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree and relevant experience in Supply Chain or Data Analytics * 3–5 years of experience in Supply Chain roles * Move seamlessly from high-level overviews to detailed data analysis * Fluent in English and communicate openly and proactively * Comfortable working with multicultural and remote teams * Understand supply chain concepts like SOP, MRP, and DRP * Knowledge of ERP systems, Master Data Management, and planning processes (Demand, Procurement, Distribution, Production) * Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools - especially Power BI. * Skilled in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerQuery * Familiar with SQL and data modeling is a plus. Ready for a new challenge? Medline thrives when everyone feels truly connected and empowered to contribute their unique insights. We aim to ensure an environment where every individual feels a strong sense of belonging and is fully engaged. We're eager to welcome applicants, regardless of background and/or lived experiences, recognizing that our differences in perspectives enables us to carry out our mission to help improve healthcare delivery and outcomes. We look forward to receiving your application. Contact Please apply below with your CV or LinkedIn profile before 30th November 2025. We look forward hearing from you! Mzdové podmienky: 1 800 EUR/month The salary consists of a base salary (listed above) + an annual bonus (paid twice a year). The base salary may be increased depending on the candidate's experience and skills. Benefity: * Annual bonus of 7% of gross annual salary, paid twice a year based on KPI performance * Transportation allowance * Seniority bonus * Meal allowance in the cafeteria * Financial reward for improvement suggestions Termín nástupu: by agreement Zaujala vás naša ponuka? Medline Assembly Slovakia je výrobným závodom v divízii jednorázových chirurgických setov (SPT- Sterile Procedure Tray), založeným v roku 2015 v Bánovciach nad Bebravou.  Vzhľadom na veľký úspech v Európe a neutíchajúci dopyt po chirurgických setoch, sa spoločnosť Medline rozhodla postaviť úplne nový, moderný výrobný závod v Partizánskom, ktorý sa spúšťa do prevádzky začiatkom roka 2022. description: Head of Product BILLDU LTD, organizačná zložka Miesto práce Bratislava, Slovensko (Pozícia umožňuje občasnú prácu z domu) Druh pracovného pomeru plný úväzok Termín nástupu Na dohode Mzdové podmienky (brutto) Od 5 000 EUR/mesiac Informácie o pracovnom mieste Náplň práce, právomoci a zodpovednosti Billdu je jeden z najúspešnejších slovenských technologických príbehov. Z jednoduchého nápadu sme vybudovali produkt, ktorý dnes používajú státisíce podnikateľov po celom svete. Zo startupu sme sa stali globálnym hráčom - s pevnými základmi, stabilným rastom a produktom, ktorý má svetové meno. Teraz prichádza ďalšia kapitola. Hľadáme Head of Product , ktorý dokáže formovať rozvoj a budúcnosť Billdu, ktorý už dokázal, že patrí medzi najlepších vo svojej kategórii a prinesie aj svoju víziu. Niekoho, kto vie, že úspech sa nerodí z náhody, ale z rozhodnutí, ktoré menia hru. Toto nie je bežná ponuka. Je to jedinečná príležitosť viesť jeden z najúspešnejších slovenských tímov a zanechať svoj rukopis na produkte, ktorý sa zo slovenského nápadu stal globálnym riešením pre podnikateľov po celom svete. Šanca, aká sa v kariére objaví možno raz a možno je to práve teraz...:) Si pripravený/á vložiť do produktu svoje srdce, energiu a víziu? Čo bude teda náplňou tohto dream jobu? Formovať produktovú stratégiu a roadmapu - premeniť víziu na jasný smer, priority a konkrétne kroky. ​Prepojiť produkt s biznis cieľmi - zabezpečiť, že každé rozhodnutie má priamy dopad na rast a dlhodobú hodnotu firmy. ​Riadiť vývoj a prioritizáciu - v spolupráci s Product Ownerom určovať, čo sa bude vyvíjať, kedy a prečo. ​Monetizácia a pricing - nastavovať stratégie, optimalizovať subscription model a hľadať nové zdroje príjmov (cross-sell, factoring, payments). ​Product-led growth - stavať rast na produkte samotnom: onboarding, konverzie, retenciu, odporúčania, experimenty a A/B testovanie. ​Spolupráca s marketingom - spájať messaging, akvizíciu a produkt do jednej rastovej stratégie. Dáta a rozhodnutia - interpretovať metriky (CAC, LTV, ARPU, churn) a robiť rozhodnutia podložené dátami. Spravodlivé odmeny, príspevok na hardvér a vzdelávanie. Máme prostredie, kde môžeš naplno využívať svoj potenciál, s podporou na ďalšie vzdelávanie a neustály rozvoj. Dostaneš Multisport kartičku na športové aktivity a relax. Budeš mať k dispozícii Game room, silent room, relax zone a mnoho ďalších vychytávok pre tvoj komfort. Budeš mať prístup k platforme s 500+kurzmi a Blinkist premium account. Vyznáte sa v kľúčových oblastiach a procesoch? Máte povedomie o modernej integrácii a nebojíte sa technológií? Páči sa vám predstava, že navrhujete moderné riešenia pre našich klientov, poradcov a zamestnancov? Ak áno, čítajte ďalej. Aký je hlavný príbeh a poslanie tejto práce? Víziou tímu Architektúry je navrhovať riešenia pre našu úspešnú budúcnosť. Chceme byť modernou a digitálnou spoločnosťou. Pred nami je cesta, ktorá zahŕňa digitalizáciu procesov, modernizáciu aplikačného portfólia a zavádzanie inovácií. Potrebujeme niekoho, kto nám na tejto ceste pomôže. Ako Solution Architect budete zodpovedať za niektoré projekty, spolupracovať s business analytikmi a ďalšími architektmi a podieľať sa na návrhu riešení, ktoré sú funkčné, moderné, rozšíriteľné a zapadajú do zvyšku aplikačného portfólia. Samozrejme bude potrebné dohliadnuť na interné aj externé vývojové tímy, aby to, čo sa reálne vytvorí, zodpovedalo tomu, čo sme navrhli. A to, čo už raz vytvoríme, musíme rozumne zdokumentovať tak, aby sme mohli v budúcnosti na našu prácu plynule nadviazať, bez nutnosti venovať sa nezábavnej „archeológii“. Aké je oddelenie Enterprise Architektúry v UNIQA? Naše oddelenie má momentálne spolu 6 členov. Všetci máme otvorenú myseľ, žiadna prekážka pre nás nie je neprekonateľná a robíme veci s vedomím, že to, čo teraz navrhneme, s nami bude mnoho rokov, ovplyvní stovky zamestnancov a milióny klientov. description: DevOps Engineer Insignia Lifestyle Services s. r. o. Place of work Digital Park, Einsteinova, Petržalka Contract type full-time, trade licence Start date ASAP Wage (gross) 3 500 EUR/month Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Insignia Group of Companies is one of the most bespoke high-end lifestyle management and payment service groups in the world. We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic Bratislava team. We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to join our team and help us modernize, automate, and optimise our infrastructure. Our primary environments are workloads hosted in our on-premises datacenter, Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 . The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines from scratch, planning and managing the gradual migration of critical services from on-premises to cloud and introducing modern DevOps best practices across the organization. What You Will Be Doing CI/CD Implementation & Automation Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines tailored to our applications and services. Automate builds, testing, deployments, and monitoring. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep. Cloud Migration Drive the process of strategic migration of critical services from on-premises datacenter to cloud. Design migration roadmaps that minimize downtime and risk while maximizing efficiency and scalability. Ensure hybrid cloud solutions operate seamlessly during the transition phase. Infrastructure Management Manage and optimize resources across cloud and on-premises servers. Monitor, secure, and maintain infrastructure availability and performance. Ensure services are scalable and resilient during and after migration. Collaboration & Process Improvement Partner with development and IT teams to coordinate cloud adoption and DevOps processes. Introduce modern practices such as GitOps, containerization, and automated testing. Drive cultural adoption of DevOps principles within the organization. Security & Compliance Ensure infrastructure and pipelines adhere to security, compliance, and governance standards. Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to improve system reliability and visibility. What You Bring Strong experience with Azure (IaaS, PaaS, networking, security) and Microsoft 365 environments. AWS considered a plus. Strong experience with Unix Proven experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or similar tools. Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code ( Ansible, Terraform, Bicep, ARM ). Knowledge of scripting and automation ( PowerShell, Python, Bash ). Experience with containerization ( Docker, Kubernetes ) and modern deployment practices. Experience with Databases & Data Management : MS SQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis. Experience with message brokers: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka. Proven experience planning and executing cloud migrations from on-premises environments. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently. Excellent communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams. Proactive mindset with eagerness to introduce and drive new technologies. Employee perks, benefits ​- working for one of the best international lifestyle management companies ​- working with young highly motivated team ​- provided with trainings and continuing education ​- 25 vacation days ​- other corporate benefits​ Information about the selection process Please send CV in English only. Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position Follow-up/Higher Professional Education University education (Bachelor's degree) University education (Master's degree) Language skills English - Advanced (C1) Experience in the position/sector Finance, Banking, Payments Number of years of experience 3 Personality requirements and skills 3-5+ years in a DevOps or similar role. Knowledge of monitoring / observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, ELK, Site24x7). Experience with hybrid identity management (Azure AD, ADFS). Familiarity with security best practices and compliance frameworks. Previous experience modernising legacy systems into cloud-native or containerised environments. Familiarity with datacenter administration (Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualization, storage, networking) is considered a plus. Experience with Dynamics 365 deployment and integration is considered a plus. Experience in Finance, Banking or other regulated industries is considered a plus. We are more than a service provider; we are curators of extraordinary experiences and stewards of wealth and lifestyle. Our philosophy is rooted in bespoke service, granting our clients exclusive access to the finest in luxury, emerging trends, and a global network of distinguished partners and industry specialists. Headquartered in London, with a growing presence across the Globe our reach enables us to offer unparalleled solutions across all aspects of luxury and financial management. Innovation is at our core, and our clients’ satisfaction is the driving force behind everything we do. At Insignia, we foster a culture of independent thinking, assertiveness, and collaboration, where each team member is empowered to contribute to our continued success and the delivery of extraordinary results. Zaoberáme sa hlavne vývojom webových stránok, webových aplikácií a eshopov. Potrebné sú znalosti HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript na profi úrovni. A ak sa pri práci nestratíš v žiadnom inom frameworku ani ecommerce systéme, poznáš a máš skúsenosť napríklad s PHP, Git, Vue.js, React alebo iný JS framework, TypeScript, prípadne Laravel, TYPO3 alebo Shopware, je to len výhoda. Dôležité pre nás je, že: Máš otvorenú myseľ a chuť učiť sa nové veci. Vieš si poradiť s každým problémom. Si samostatný alebo samostatná pri hľadaní riešení a efektívny/ efektívna pri riešení úloh. Pridelené úlohy riešiš kvalitne, zodpovedne a včas. Tvoja práca ťa baví. Ovládaš AJ na pokročilej úrovni, prípadne vieš aj po nemecky. Hľadáš krátkodobú (1 rok) alebo dlhodobú spoluprácu. Zamestnanecké výhody, benefity Najobľúbenejšie benefity našich zamestnancov: Máme priateľskú firemnú kultúru, nápoje aj občerstvenie na pracovisku, spontánne tímbildingy a pravidelné firemné eventy. V peknej kancelárii máme miesto na oddych, dobrú kávu a playstation. V rámci socializácie máme aj spoločné kávové prestávky. Máme kanceláriu v Bratislave ale ponúkame aj možnosť občasnej práce z domu - väčšinu času pracujeme v našich priestoroch, ale ak potrebuješ pracovať z domu, lebo deti majú prázdniny alebo príde kuriér, vždy sa dohodneme. Na prácu používame Apple MacBook. Máme Multisport Kartu. Ak máš záujem, podporujeme osobný a profesný rast. Preplácame konferencie a koding eventy. Zamestnancom dávame príležitosť pre kariérny postup. Vítame aj ambície prevziať vedúcu úlohu v tíme. Ale nikoho nenútime. Máme aj ďalšie benefity, o tých kľudne osobne. Po vzájomnej dohode nastupuješ do práce. Ďakujeme všetkým za záujem. Odpovedať budeme iba vybraným uchádzačom. Sídlime v Bratislave ale niektorí kolegovia a kolegyne pracujú aj z domu, z rôznych kútov Slovenska. Zaoberáme sa vývojom webových stránok a webových aplikácií, ktoré pomáhajú našim klientom a ich zákazníkom uspieť. Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Software Engineer The Future Begins Here At Takeda, we are creating a future-ready organization that uses data and digital to meet the needs of patients, our people, and the planet. We need your help to make this happen. Join our new Innovation Capability Center (ICC) in Bratislava, Slovakia. In this role at our state-of-the-art center, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and create solutions that will benefit patients around the world. Become the heart of our internal innovation engine. At Takeda we unite in diversity Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive workplace, where individuals are recognized for the diverse backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continually improving workplace experience and accessibility for everyone, and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our Team. The Opportunity As a Software Engineer, you will play a role in bringing new digital health products to address patients pain points and optimize healthcare delivery. You will provide technical expertise in innovative product development, ensuring seamless integration and efficient utilization of relevant technologies. With your experience, you will build user-centric health tech solutions, integrate with our technical ecosystem, and be a member of an agile team of top-tier developers for Takeda to succeed in this mission. Responsibilities Deliver      high-quality modern user experiences built in modern Front-End and      Back-End (Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript) frameworks and      libraries . Utilize      APIs, connectors, and middleware tools to achieve system      interoperability. Leverage      best practices, Object Oriented JavaScript programming and TypeScript      frameworks. Builds      systems of medium-to-high complexity with minimal guidance and      supervision. Build      interfaces for modern internet applications using the latest front-end and      back-end technologies. Implement      reusable libraries across applications. Write      unit and integration tests for all application code. Ensure      responsive design works across computing platforms. Develop      application code and unit tests in selected framework and/or      library. Ensure      high performance for global users through performance tests and      tuning. Partner      with the design team around usability and UI/UX concerns. Collaborate      with more senior team members to implement feedback on pull request      reviews. Collaborate      with agile team members to craft clear user stories and continuously      deliver product increments. Continuously      collaborate with Product Owner to demo developed functionality and      validate against specified requirements. Estimate      work based on user stories and functional requirements or      wireframes. Employee perks, benefits What Takeda Can Offer You At Takeda, you may build your career, while contributing to better people’s lives. Expect trust driven culture built around Integrity, Fairness, Honesty and Perseverance. Joining ICC will give you access to high-end technology, training and colleagues who will support your growth. Benefits Here are a few benefits our employees are enjoying at Takeda. To get a full picture of what we are offering, go to bit.ly/icc-bts-benefits - Cafeteria - Medical - High standard medical care - Bridge days - Summer Hours - Multisport Card Your application and any and all conversations that occur with the recruiter, HR, and the hiring manager as part of that application will be treated in the strictest confidence. Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position University education (Bachelor's degree) Language skills English - Upper intermediate (B2) Personality requirements and skills Skills and Qualifications Bachelor’s      degree in computer science or a related study, or equivalent      experience. 4+      years of relevant professional experience in developing software. Solid      hands-on experience as a full-stack engineer focused on front-end with      following tech stack: Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience      with back-end development using Node.js is a plus! Hands-on      experience developing solutions on AWS (serverless and other Platform As A      Service modules of cloud platform) is a big advantage. Experience      in prototyping, as well as operating at scale, with focus on writing      clean, encapsulated and well documented code. Experience      in designing and implementing integrations between systems using      middleware tools. Familiarity with various integration patterns,      protocols, and technologies (such as REST, SOAP, JSON, XML). Adept      at analyzing complex technical issues, identifying root causes, and      implementing effective solutions. Proficient in debugging, performance      optimization, and troubleshooting mobile/web applications. Solid      communication skills, a team player with a 'winning as a team'      attitude. Ability      to continuously enhances own skills. Ability      to write and speak in the English language. Practice      efficient time management and coordinates tasks, working in an      international environment. Advertiser Brief description of the company Takeda is an industry-leading, global pharmaceutical company with an unwavering dedication to putting patients at the center of everything we do. We live our values of Takeda-ism – Integrity, Fairness, Honesty, and Perseverance – and are united by our mission to strive towards Better Health and a Brighter Future for people worldwide through leading innovation in medicine. Here, everyone matters and you will be a vital contributor to our inspiring, bold mission. At Takeda, you will make an impact on people’s lives – including your own. Takeda is an equal opportunity employer. We are taking a giant step forward to create a future-ready organization that evolves at the speed of science and technology, to meet the needs of patients by seeking and incorporating novel digital capabilities, data, and agile methodologies. Our aim is to provide digital solutions that are personalized to each patient’s unique needs and health circumstances. With individual care at the center, we can support patients in actively managing their personal care journey – from the moment they are diagnosed through treatment and beyond. Our flagship robot, the Brightpick Autopicker, is truly unique: a robotic platform in place of feet, a robotic arm instead of a hand, a 3D scanner for vision, and AI algorithms as its brain — all seamlessly integrated to enable autonomous movement and intelligent decision-making. Why Brightpick? Fully in-house tech: from hardware to AI & algorithms. Also design and manufacturing! Rapid rollout and proven results in the EU and US A place where you can thrive and accelerate your career growth Headquartered in Bratislava, but delivering our solutions all around the world, we’re a tight-knit team of 200+ engineers, builders, and problem-solvers. We move fast, think bold, build technology that matters. Pridaj sa k Brightpick - Kde ožívajú robotické aplikácie spolu s AI V Brightpicku vytvárame inteligentné roboty, ktoré riešia komplexné logistické výzvy pomocou pokročilej umelej inteligencie, počítačového videnia a autonómnej mobility. Náš vlajkový robot, Brightpick Autopicker, je skutočne jedinečný. Robotická platforma namiesto nôh, robotické rameno namiesto ruky, 3D skener ako oči a AI algoritmy ako rozum. Všetko dokonale integrované pre autonómny pohyb a inteligentné rozhodovanie. Prečo Brightpick? Naše vlastné technológie: od hardvéru až po AI a algoritmy. A tiež samotné dizajnovanie a výroba robotov! Rýchla implementácia a preukázateľné výsledky v EÚ a USA Miesto, kde môžeš napredovať a urýchliť svoj kariérny rast Naše sídlo je v Bratislave, no naše riešenia dodávame po celom svete. Sme zohratý tím viac ako 200 inžinierov, vývojárov a riešiteľov problémov. Vďaka nášmu nasadeniu a práci, ktorá nás napĺňa, budujeme technológie, na ktorých záleží. Senior Project Manager / Project Engineer (Static Equipment) Place of work Plynárenská 4937/6, Ružinov Contract type full-time Wage (gross) From 2 500 EUR/month Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Brightpick is revolutionizing warehouse automation with cutting-edge robotic solutions and intelligent systems that power some of the world’s most advanced fulfillment centers. We design and deliver technology that helps customers achieve operational excellence with speed, precision, and reliability. We’re looking for a Project Manager – Engineering (Static Equipment) to lead all aspects of warehouse static equipment design, procurement, and delivery — including shelving systems, tote storage, flow racks, and all supporting infrastructure that ensures safety, compliance, and performance. As the Project Manager – Engineering (Static Equipment), you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of static infrastructure for Brightpick customer deployments. From the moment a project is scoped during pre-sales to the final handover of a fully operational system, you’ll ensure every structural element is designed, engineered, and delivered to meet performance, safety, and regulatory standards. This is a high-impact technical leadership role, working cross-functionally with Sales, Solution Engineering, Procurement, Project Execution, and external vendors in both the EU and the US. Location Bratislava Type of employment Full-time Salary (brutto) From 2500 € / month based on seniority and experience Core responsibilities: Lead full lifecycle management of static warehouse equipment — from design and specification to procurement, installation, and commissioning. Evaluate and select solutions for shelving systems, tote storage, flow racks, mezzanines, and related infrastructure to meet project requirements. Ensure compliance with all structural, fire suppression, and seismic zone standards, including local building codes, NFPA, IBC, and EN regulations. Define and enforce engineering specifications, including load calculations, floor flatness tolerances, clearances, and system interfaces. Collaborate with Sales and Pre-Sales teams to determine optimal product selection and layout during solution design. Manage and coordinate vendor engagements, technical reviews, customization requirements, and delivery timelines. Drive cost optimization and risk mitigation, ensuring quality and compliance without compromising delivery schedules. Provide technical leadership and oversight during on-site installations, inspections, and final acceptance testing. Maintain strong project documentation, including drawings, BOMs, engineering approvals, and change orders. Serve as the internal SME for all static equipment topics across Brightpick’s global project portfolio. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical / Structural / Industrial Engineering or related field Solid senior experience managing warehouse infrastructure or material handling equipment projects Strong understanding of warehouse rack systems, structural design principles, fire suppression systems, and seismic compliance Proven experience in vendor selection, procurement, and managing technical scope with third-party suppliers Excellent understanding of building and fire codes in EU and/or US Ability to interpret engineering drawings, structural calculations, and design standards Strong project management skills — planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk management Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and commercial stakeholders Willingness to travel to customer sites Fluent in Slovak and English Benefits: Daily breakfast in the office Option of working from home/hybrid work (in case the position allows it) Flexible work schedule (in case the position allows it) Sick days Parking for everyone, bike storage with showers and changing rooms on site at our HQ Rooftop terrace with nice view of Bratislava Dog friendly office Multisport Card Referral program Additional benefits you can choose from after 1st year: Multisport Card (with company contribution) Contribution to a recreation stay Year-round healthcare access at ProCare Supplementary pension contribution (III pilier) Brain boost - budget for professional development Annual public transportation pass E-Shop voucher to buy anything you might need Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position University education (Master's degree) Language skills English - Advanced (C1) and Slovak - Proficiency (C2) Advertiser Brief description of the company The journey of our company started in 2013 when 4 friends came up with the idea to provide eyes for robots worldwide so that they could see and understand it. This idea led to a series of patents and awards. Shortly thereafter, the four-man company grew into a 200+ people technological sanctuary for machine vision and smart automation enthusiasts & innovators. The company has offices in the USA and Slovakia, from where we  deliver machine vision technology and robotic intelligence software to almost every country in the world. Today, Brightpick helps companies improve the performance and efficiency of countless applications in manufacturing, fulfillment, and assembly, including bin picking and pick & place tasks, robot guidance, machine tending, inspection & quality control, or 3D model creation. In 2021 Photoneo launched its new Business Unit BRIGHTPICK, the first fully automated fulfillment solution for warehouses and grocers and added to its broad competences and industries served. In early 2025 the sensor/3D vision part of the company (‘’Photoneo’’) was acquired by Zebra Technologies. We got renamed to Brightpick and started to offer a warehouse automation solution for ecommerce and grocery fulfillment. Being a part of Brightpick means being a part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries further and creates space for solutions of the future. Join us and experience the journey with us! title: Senior Support Specialist & Team Leader
description: Senior Support Specialist & Team Leader NetCore j.s.a. Place of work Garbiarska 2, Košice Contract type full-time Start date upon agreement Wage (gross) From 2 935 EUR/month Final salary depends on experience and type of contract. Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Who we are We’re a Slovak software company developing our own network automation and configuration management platform — Unimus. The entire product is built in-house, and currently deployed in over 3000 networks worldwide. Our software runs in production across a broad range of environments — from small business networks, through enterprise data centers, regional ISPs, to national-scale telcos and carriers. Unimus automates backup, change tracking, configuration auditing, and other essential network operations tasks across over a million devices. Every support case we solve improves not just our customer’s infrastructure, but also the product itself. We're not building software for someone else. We own the roadmap, the code, and the support. And we’re hiring someone to help us take our support to the next level. What you’ll do We're looking for a hands-on technical expert who’s also ready to lead. This role combines deep technical support work with team leadership. You’ll handle complex issues, work directly with technical customers, and lead a small team of experienced support engineers. You'll take ownership of the entire ticket lifecycle, from triage to resolution — including direct collaboration with developers on bugs, escalations, or feature feedback. You’ll also be responsible for improving our internal support processes, tooling, and overall support quality. Lead and mentor a small team (currently 2 senior support engineers + you), while setting the standard for support quality and execution Solve complex technical support cases — involving routers, switches, the Linux ecosystem, or issues in our own software stack Handle the support lifecycle end-to-end: ticket intake, triage, resolution, and follow-up with dev when necessary Jump on live troubleshooting calls with technical customers (typically network admins or sysadmins) Own team priorities, ensure the ticket queue flows, and nothing critical gets missed Work closely with sales on customer prioritization and reporting Improve internal tooling, workflows, and documentation — and shape how our support works This role requires structure, discipline, and a clear head — but also empathy and curiosity. Behind every ticket is a person who just wants their infrastructure to work. Who you’ll be talking to We don’t do end-user support. All our users are highly technical — network administrators, sysadmins, DevOps engineers, etc. You’ll talk to people who know their way around routers, Linux and shells, and expect the same from you. What you should know already You should have solid hands-on experience in both networking and Linux system administration — this role requires depth in both areas, not just familiarity. Ideally, you've worked in environments where you’ve had to diagnose and resolve real-world issues across network infrastructure and Linux systems. Core knowledge: Networking (Layer 2–4): configuring and managing routers, switches, VLANs, routing protocols Linux: command-line utilities, service management, logging, troubleshooting, deployment, iptables Bash, basic scripting, file permissions, system security Web stack basics: Apache/Nginx, databases, firewalls Nice to know: Troubleshooting tools: tcpdump, Wireshark Docker, Git, GitHub PKI, Linux hardening, firewalling If you don’t know every one of these tools, that’s fine — but you should be comfortable diving in and learning quickly. We're here to support your growth. How we work Core hours are 10:00–16:00. US timezone support (12:00–20:00) is shared within a team rotation, so you won’t cover it every week. We don’t play titles.
