title: Senior Support Specialist
description: Senior Support Specialist NetCore j.s.a. Place of work CASSOVAR, Košice Contract type full-time, part-time Start date upon agreement Wage (gross) From 2 500 EUR/month Final salary depends on experience and type of contract. Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Who we are We’re a Slovak software company developing our own network automation and configuration management platform — Unimus. The entire product is built in-house, and currently deployed in over 3000 networks worldwide. Our software runs in production across a broad range of environments — from small business networks, through enterprise data centers, regional ISPs, to national-scale telcos and carriers. Unimus automates backup, change tracking, configuration auditing, and other essential network operations tasks across over a million devices. Every support case we solve improves not just our customer’s infrastructure, but also the product itself. We're not building software for someone else. We own the roadmap, the code, and the support. And we’re hiring someone to help us take our support to the next level. What you’ll do We’re looking for someone with a solid technical background who enjoys helping customers solve interesting challenges. This role involves working closely with our software and network technologies, and you’ll work with technical customers. You’ll take ownership of the entire support ticket lifecycle, from intake to resolution, including collaboration with developers when bugs or feature feedback come up.​ Solve technical support cases — involving routers, switches, the Linux and Windows ecosystems, or issues in our own software stack Handle the support lifecycle end-to-end: ticket intake, triage, resolution, and follow-up with dev when necessary Participate in troubleshooting calls and live chat with customers (typically network admins or sysadmins) Ensure that the ticket queue flows, and nothing critical gets missed Contribute to improving our internal tools, workflows, and documentation — and help make our support even smoother Provide clear, courteous responses to customers and actively work to find solutions, even if it requires additional communication or research Focus on customer satisfaction: your goal is to resolve issues in a way that meets the customer’s needs Work independently in support, with guidance from the team on highly technical issues This role benefits from organization, and calm problem-solving — but also empathy and curiosity. Behind every ticket is a person who just wants their infrastructure to work. Who you’ll be talking to We don’t do end-user support. All our users are technical — network administrators, sysadmins, DevOps engineers, etc. You’ll talk to people who know their way around routers, Linux and shells, and appreciate working with someone who can speak their language. What you should know already You should have practical experience in either networking or Linux and Windows system administration, enough to troubleshoot and help customers effectively. Ideally, you've worked in environments where you’ve had to diagnose and resolve real-world issues across network infrastructure and operating systems. ​ Core knowledge: ​ Networking (Layer 2–4): configuring and managing routers, switches, VLANs, routing protocols Linux: command-line utilities, service management, logging, troubleshooting, deployment, iptables Bash, basic scripting, file permissions, system security Web stack basics: Apache/Nginx, databases, firewalls Nice to know: Troubleshooting tools: tcpdump, Wireshark Docker, Git, GitHub PKI, Linux hardening, firewalling If you don’t know every one of these tools, that’s fine — but you should be comfortable diving in and learning quickly. We're here to support your growth. How we work Core hours are 10:00–16:00. US timezone support (12:00–20:00) is shared within a team rotation, so you won’t cover it every week. We don’t play titles. Everyone knows their role, and when something doesn’t work, we talk openly — informal but professional. No support chatbots — just real engineers solving real problems. The people who built the product sit right next to us — just turn around and get things solved without unnecessary writing, scrolling, or waiting. What you won’t deal with Support for non-technical users Ignored issues — when something breaks, we fix it promptly Being on call during your vacation (or being on call at all) Unclear pay or avoiding conversations about your growth Benefits that truly matter Employee stock options - a share in the company you are helping to grow Flexible cooperation model - internal or external engagement based on your preference Extra time off - additional days of vacation between Christmas and New Year’s Professional development - we’ll support the learning method you prefer (courses, books, trainings, etc.) Burrito Fridays - yes, burritos every Friday, covered by the company Team-building events - at least four times a year, enjoyable for the whole team and their families VR, darts, and calcetto - we play daily, and occasionally organize friendly tournaments In-office massages - because eight hours at a desk can take its toll Shower and locker room - ideal if you bike to work or run in the mornings Pet-friendly office - if your dog watches over the ticket queue, feel free to bring them along Sabbatical after 3 years - take time off to recharge without guilt and on top of all that, you’ll have access to parking, too. What to expect in the process A brief introductory phone call Technical interview — focused on your support experience and Linux/networking knowledge Final round — meet the team and discuss how we’d work together We’ll make an offer if it clicks. No drawn-out process, no ghosting. Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position Secondary with school-leaving examination Language skills Slovak - Advanced (C1) and English - Advanced (C1) Advertiser Brief description of the company We are a Slovakian-founded software company dedicated to developing our own network automation and management software suite (https://unimus.net). Fully independent, we create solutions that impact the world of network management on a global scale - from small local networks to national telecom carriers. Currently, we’re enhancing our software suite by developing a new product. title: PLC Programmer
description: PLC Programmer AUMOVIO SE Place of work Cesta ku Continentalu, Zvolen-Tepličky Contract type full-time Wage (gross) 1 855 EUR/month Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties The PLC Programmer is responsible for developing, testing, and maintaining programmable logic controller (PLC) systems to ensure reliable automation processes in production and support digitalization initiatives. As a central position within Industrial Engineering, this role also sets global standards for PLC programming and maintains specifications for all plants and suppliers Design, program, and implement PLC systems for production equipment and automation projects. Modify and optimize existing PLC programs to improve efficiency and reliability. Collaborate with engineering, maintenance, and operations teams to ensure seamless integration of automation solutions. Troubleshoot and resolve PLC-related issues to minimize downtime. Ensure compliance with safety standards and cybersecurity requirements in automation systems. Document all programming changes and maintain version control. Svoje služby poskytuje od roku 2000, keď začala ponúkať bezdrôtové dátové pripojenie pre firmy v licencovanom pásme 26 Ghz. Už 20 rokov kontinuálne investuje do budovania vlastnej optickej infraštruktúry, čím sa odlišuje od väčšiny alternatívnych operátorov. Spoločnosť SWAN ako prvá na Slovensku začala s masívnym budovaním a poskytovaním služieb na technológii LTE. Svojou optickou sieťou a fixným LTE pripojením pokrýva tisíce domácností vo viac ako 400 mestách a obciach po celom Slovensku. Od roku 2008 tiež poskytuje tzv. triple play služby pre domácnosti. Svoje služby začala 4ka ponúkať v doteraz bezkonkurenčne najširšej predajnej sieti viac ako 1600 pobočiek Slovenskej pošty. Application Mechatronics Engineer Place of work Bratislava, Slovak Republic Contract type full-time Wage (gross) From 2 000 EUR/month Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties About this role This role requires a solid foundation in electronics and embedded programming, combined with a creative and hands-on approach to problem-solving. You will be responsible for developing and testing electronic components and modules that form the core of our advanced automation systems. Experience with servo drives and a passion for designing and building functional prototypes are essential. You will be joining a collaborative team of five experienced engineers who are eager to share their knowledge and support your growth. Location Bratislava, Slovakia Type of employment Full-time Salary (brutto) From € 2000/month based on seniority and experience Reports to Mechatronics Team Leader Core responsibilities: Testing of electronic components and integrated circuits for automation systems. Create and execute test scenarios for complex mechatronics modules and systems, documenting results and reporting bugs. Implement technical solutions according to specifications, ensuring functionality and reliability. Diagnose and troubleshoot issues in electronic components and modules using various tools (e.g., oscilloscopes, multimeters). Build functional prototypes to validate designs and demonstrate feasibility. Propose new functionalities and improvements based on in-house testing and research. Create clear and concise instructions for mass production. Prepare systems for serial production, ensuring smooth transition from development to manufacturing. Maintain comprehensive documentation related to designs, testing, and production processes. Collaborate effectively with the Mechatronics team and other departments. Contribute to meeting departmental and project deadlines, effectively managing multiple projects simultaneously. Deploy technology at customer locations, including occasional travel (up to 10%, primarily domestic). Requirements: Essential: C/C++ programming for embedded systems. Experience with PLC programming Knowledge of Ethernet TCP/IP protocol Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS). Understanding of low-level communication protocols (I2C, SPI, RS-232, RS-485). Experience with servo drives and drivers Familiarity with sensors commonly used in automation (e.g., proximity sensors, encoders, vision systems, etc.). Electrical certification under "Paragraph 21 or 22" Desirable: Familiarity with industrial automation or robotics. Practical knowledge of electronics, including circuit design and analysis using relevant software tools. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to use diagnostic tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, etc.). Excellent teamwork and communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively. English language proficiency (B2 level or higher) Benefits: Daily breakfast in the office Option of working from home/hybrid work (in case the position allows it) Flexible work schedule (in case the position allows it) Sick days Parking for everyone, bike storage with showers and changing rooms on site at our HQ Rooftop terrace with nice view of Bratislava Dog friendly office Multisport Card Referral program Additional benefits you can choose from after 1st year: Multisport Card (with company contribution) Contribution to a recreation stay Year-round healthcare access at ProCare Supplementary pension contribution (III pilier) Brain boost - budget for professional development Annual public transportation pass E-Shop voucher to buy anything you might need Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position Follow-up/Higher Professional Education Language skills English - Upper intermediate (B2) Advertiser Brief description of the company The journey of our company started in 2013 when 4 friends came up with the idea to provide eyes for robots worldwide so that they could see and understand it. This idea led to a series of patents and awards. Shortly thereafter, the four-man company grew fast, becoming a technological sanctuary for machine vision, smart automation enthusiasts & innovators. In 2021 Photoneo launched its new Business Unit BRIGHTPICK, the first fully automated fulfillment solution for warehouses and grocers and added to its broad competences and industries served. In early 2025 the sensor/3D vision part of the company (‘’Photoneo’’) was acquired by Zebra Technologies, marking a significant and celebrated tech acquisition in Slovak history. We, the remaining part of the company, were rebranded as Brightpick, with hubs in the USA and EU (with main HQ in Slovakia), dedicated to providing global automation solutions for e-commerce and grocery fulfillment. Being a part of Brightpick means being a part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries further and creates space for solutions of the future. Join us and experience the journey with us! Within the HR Headquarters, our People Development team drives global HR products such as learning, skills intelligence, engagement and performance management — making Telekom the best place to develop, grow, and raise the voice. Contract type full-time Place of work Košice, Slovak Republic Start date ASAP Wage (gross) From 2 700 EUR/month About the position As Product Manager for Intelligent Learning Solutions, you’ll build the next generation of digital learning products that reach 50,000+ employees a year — experiences that feel more like Spotify or Duolingo than traditional corporate training. You’ll combine product strategy, systems thinking, and applied AI to build tools and journeys that accelerate performance, engagement, and skill growth — all embedded into the flow of work and powered by our enterprise LLM assistant. Translate business capability needs into digital products that deliver measurable outcomes. Work with engineers and designers to embed learning into core digital platforms (Teams, intranet, corporate LLM). Manage the product backlog, define success metrics, and run agile sprints with internal and external partners. We work in a HYBRID STYLE of working. The published salary is the minimum possible offer. The starting salary may be higher depending on the extent of fulfillment of the employee's requirements (education, language skills, required practice, personality assumptions and skills). What we expect Candidates with education suit the position University education (Master's degree) Language skills English - Advanced (C1) Personality requirements and skills 5+ years’ experience in product management or digital product design — ideally in SaaS, edtech, or digital experience products. Deep understanding of user experience, journey design, and data-driven iteration. Comfort working with AI technologies, APIs, or conversational interfaces. Systems thinker — you see how multiple digital touchpoints connect to create continuous experiences. Comfortable translating complexity into simple, intuitive digital flows. Data-literate — you use analytics to inform decisions and prove business impact. Curious about human learning and performance, but not constrained by traditional L&D models. Entrepreneurial — you build, test, learn, and iterate fast. Nice to have: o Background in edtech, behavior change, or human-centered AI. o Familiarity with LLMs, adaptive learning, or simulation-based experiences. o Experience working with design systems or personalization engines. o Technical literacy in APIs, no-code tools, or prototyping platforms. Pracovná náplň: Do nášho sporkárskeho tímu hľadáme nového kolegu alebo novú kolegyňu na pozíciu DevOps Engineer, ktorý/ktorá bude hnacou silou automatizácie naprieč našimi systémami a aplikáciami. Očakávame, že prinesieš inovatívne prístupy, budeš využívať moderné technológie a pomôžeš nám zefektívniť každodenné operácie naprieč celou bankou. Ak ťa baví hľadať lepšie riešenia, posúvať veci dopredu a výzvy berieš ako príležitosť, budeš sa u nás cítiť ako doma. Čomu sa budeš venovať? navrhovať a implementovať štandardy automatizácie naprieč celým lifecycle-om dodávania zmien spravovať a rozvíjať kontajnerovú platformu OpenShift spravovať a rozvíjať nástroje našej DevSecOps platformy (GitLab, Jenkins, Nexus, SAST/DAST nástroje) spolupracovať na vývoji a správe CI/CD pipelines poskytovať podporu pre onboarding a prevádzku aplikácií na OpenShift platforme optimalizovať existujúce procesy poskytovať podporu pre členov tímu a ostatné oddelenia Uvítame, ak budeš mať: máš skúsenosti s programovaním – ideálne v Pythone, Go alebo Bash/Shell si doma v technológiách ako Kubernetes, OpenShift, GitLab, Nexus, Jenkins, Ansible či Helm vieš, čo znamená mať systémy pod dohľadom – poznáš Elastic, Prometheus alebo Grafanu rozumieš princípom DevOps a máš skúsenosti s CI/CD máš skúsenosť s cloudom – ak nie, chuť doňho ponoriť sa je veľké plus premýšľaš analyticky, riešiš problémy logicky si proaktívny/proaktívna a rád/rada sa učíš nové veci Poď s nami dokončovať to, čo sme načali a my ťa odmeníme: Tvoju prácu u nás si vážime. Odmeníme ťa 13. platom a ročným bonusom. Extra money za úsilie navyše. Na kvalitné jedlo ti prispejeme 8€. Stravné hradíme v plnom rozsahu, a to aj v dňoch keď dovolenkuješ. Participuj aj na úspechoch banky, cez zamestnanecký programe sa staneš akcionárom, akcionárkou skupiny ERSTE. Chceme spolupracovať s ľuďmi, s ktorými radi trávite čas. Odporuč nám nových kolegov a kolegyne, a my ťa odmeníme sumou až do 1000€. Urob si radosť, prispejeme ti na ňu 264€ ročne. Na to, aby si bol/a na dôchodku finančne fit ti prispejeme do III. piliera. Pre lepšie vyváženie práce a súkromia alebo, aby ste stihli dokončiť načaté aj doma: Dovolenkuj s nami až o 5 dní navyše. Voľný deň - pre rodiča budúceho prváčika pri jeho/jej prvom školskom dni, pri darovaní krvi, pri nadštandardnej zdravotnej prehliadke. Ťažkosti súkromné aj pracovné môžeš riešiť cez psychologickú podporu, prostredníctvom linky pomoci pre našich zamestnancov. Zdravotný stav teba a tvojich blízkych ťa vďaka nám nezaskočí – využiť môžeš našu digitálnu ordináciu, ktorá ti je k dispozícií doma aj v zahraničí Veríme, že v zdravom tele je zdravý duch, športuj s Multisport aj UpBalansea kartou. Vzdelávaj sa a dokončuj svoje štúdia, veríme, že ti v tom pomôžu workshopy, ktoré pripravujeme spolu s platformou SEDUO. Oddychovať môžeš aj vďaka „Lucky“ time. description: O nás Voľné pozície Benefity EN SK Staň sa súčasťou tímu vizionárov Vytvárajme spolu budúcnosť kybernetickej bezpečnosti späť na voľné pracovné miesta Experienced Machine Learning Researcher Place of work Bratislava, Slovakia (Job with occasional home office) Wage (gross) From 3 000 EUR/month * The final basic wage component can be increased accordingly to individual skills and experience of the selected candidate. * Performance bonus 2 times per year up to 10% of the basic salary paid for the evaluation period(usually 6 months). Contract type full-time We are looking for a passionate and experienced Machine Learning Researcher to join our Technology Division, preferably someone with a strong foundation in machine learning, whether built through academic research, personal projects, or industry experience. While this role is intended for highly skilled researchers, we also welcome exceptionally talented individuals who may not have extensive work experience but demonstrate deep understanding, curiosity, and a strong drive to advance the field. To be clear from the start: we are not just another company jumping on the current machine learning/artificial intelligence hype. Our experts have been working with machine learning for more than 20 years, with neural networks making their first appearance in our products back in 1998. What does working as a Machine Learning Researcher entail? A Machine Learning Researcher is responsible for exploring and proposing novel approaches to leverage data for threat detection. The role involves designing and executing experiments, analyzing results, and determining the next steps in the development of advanced machine learning models. The main project builds on heuristic correlations of behavioral data, which are subsequently evaluated using cutting-edge machine learning models. The position requires a strong experimental mindset, adaptability to evolving data, and a focus on delivering robust and effective solutions. While the primary focus is on research, the position also includes aspects of ML-Ops, such as deploying, monitoring, and refining models in production, which can be expanded depending on the candidate’s interests and expertise. Where does the Machine Learning Researcher work? The position is part of the Technology Division located in Bratislava. The team works extensively with behavioral data stored in a large-scale big data infrastructure. There are multiple specialized groups within the team: some focus on heuristic modeling to correlate behavioral signals, others are dedicated to threat simulation and synthetic data generation. The group for which this position is open is responsible for developing and improving machine learning models and solutions. These groups collaborate closely, sharing expertise and findings across domains to achieve common goals. In addition to internal collaboration, the team works closely with other departments involved in data collection, manual incident evaluation and handling, as well as with software development teams. This cross-functional cooperation ensures that research efforts are grounded in real-world needs and can be effectively translated into impactful, production-ready solutions. Technologies used in the job Python, Scikit, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hadoop, Scylla, Spark, Flink, Hive, Impala, Kafka, (My)SQL, JIRA, Confluence, Git, MLflow, Airflow, Jenkins, Docker, K8s The advantages You will be creating something that truly helps protect millions of users worldwide. You will also have the opportunity to learn new things and apply machine learning approaches in the cybersecurity field—an area mastered by only a handful of people. Are you cut out for the job? Since this is a dedicated research (or applied research) position, we are primarily looking for candidates with a university education, Master’s or higher degree, in a machine learning-related field. Candidates with backgrounds in Data Science, Computer Science, Data Mining, or Statistics are welcome, ideally with previous work in the field. The candidate should be proficient enough in programming to create prototypes in Python. Experience with Big Data technologies and at least a basic understanding of computer/network security are considered advantages. And last but not least, to keep pace with the bad guys, a healthy appetite for continuous learning is essential. The appetite for drinks, beers, food, and a great time will be satisfied at several off-site teambuilding activities, our annual Christmas party, and the big company event known as Zranica. title: Electronics & Embedded Systems Engineer
description: Join Brightpick – Where Real-World AI and Robotics Comes to Life At Brightpick, we build intelligent robots that solve complex logistics challenges using advanced AI, computer vision, and autonomous mobility. Our flagship robot, the Brightpick Autopicker, is truly unique: a robotic platform in place of feet, a robotic arm instead of a hand, a 3D scanner for vision, and AI algorithms as its brain — all seamlessly integrated to enable autonomous movement and intelligent decision-making. Why Brightpick? Fully in-house tech: from hardware to AI & algorithms. Also design and manufacturing! Rapid rollout and proven results in the EU and US A place where you can thrive and accelerate your career growth Headquartered in Bratislava, but delivering our solutions all around the world, we’re a tight-knit team of 200+ engineers, builders, and problem-solvers. We move fast, think bold, build technology that matters. Pridaj sa k Brightpick - Kde ožívajú robotické aplikácie spolu s AI V Brightpicku vytvárame inteligentné roboty, ktoré riešia komplexné logistické výzvy pomocou pokročilej umelej inteligencie, počítačového videnia a autonómnej mobility. Náš vlajkový robot, Brightpick Autopicker, je skutočne jedinečný. Robotická platforma namiesto nôh, robotické rameno namiesto ruky, 3D skener ako oči a AI algoritmy ako rozum. Všetko dokonale integrované pre autonómny pohyb a inteligentné rozhodovanie. Prečo Brightpick? Naše vlastné technológie: od hardvéru až po AI a algoritmy. A tiež samotné dizajnovanie a výroba robotov! Rýchla implementácia a preukázateľné výsledky v EÚ a USA Miesto, kde môžeš napredovať a urýchliť svoj kariérny rast Naše sídlo je v Bratislave, no naše riešenia dodávame po celom svete. Sme zohratý tím viac ako 200 inžinierov, vývojárov a riešiteľov problémov. Vďaka nášmu nasadeniu a práci, ktorá nás napĺňa, budujeme technológie, na ktorých záleží. Electronics & Embedded Systems Engineer Place of work Plynárenská 4937/6, Ružinov Contract type full-time Wage (gross) 2 400 EUR/month Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Brightpick is revolutionizing warehouse automation with cutting-edge robotic solutions and intelligent systems that power some of the world’s most advanced fulfillment centers. We design and deliver technology that helps customers achieve operational excellence with speed, precision, and reliability. We are looking for a creative and hands-on Electronics & Embedded Systems Engineer to join our Mechatronics team. You will work alongside smart colleagues to design the "brain and nervous system" of our Autonomous Mobile Robots and complex automation machinery. The Role As an Electronics & Embedded Systems Engineer, you will bridge the gap between mechanical hardware and intelligent software. Your primary goal is to design, prototype, and implement electronic components and integrated circuits that drive our automation solutions. You will handle the full spectrum of electronics engineering—from designing circuits and building rough "proof-of-concept" prototypes to developing low-level embedded software and finalizing instructions for mass production. This role requires a deep understanding of servo drives, sensors, and the communication protocols that make industrial automation tick. Location Bratislava Type of employment Full-time Salary (brutto) From € 2400/month based on seniority and experience Core responsibilities: Execute functional and technical design of electronic components, PCBs, and integrated circuits for robotics and industrial automation. Develop low-level embedded software and firmware, ensuring robust communication between subsystems. Build and test functional prototypes to validate concepts quickly; diagnostics and functionality are prioritized over aesthetics during the prototyping phase. Prepare systems for mass production, creating comprehensive manufacturing instructions and documentation to ensure scalability. Integrate servo drives and automation sensors, defining control logic and ensuring precise actuation and data feedback. Design and maintain software development processes, ensuring code quality, version control, and reliability. Manage technical governance, overseeing safety certifications and ensuring designs meet industrial compliance standards. Collaborate on multiple projects simultaneously, working closely with the Mechatronics Team Leader to meet departmental deadlines. Support onsite deployment (approx. 10% travel), assisting with the installation and commissioning of technology at customer locations Requirements: Master’s degree (M.Sc.) in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field. Solid real-life experience with Low-Level and Embedded Programming (C/C++). Deep knowledge of low-level communication protocols (I2C, SPI, RS-232, RS-485); knowledge of Ethernet TCP/IP is a strong advantage. Proven capability in designing electrical circuits and diagnosing electronic components. Strong practical understanding of servo drives and automation sensors. Ability to prioritize functionality and problem-solving over perfectionism during the prototyping phase. PLC programming experience is considered a significant advantage. This idea led to a series of patents and awards. Shortly thereafter, the four-man company grew fast, becoming a technological sanctuary for machine vision, smart automation enthusiasts & innovators. In 2021 Photoneo launched its new Business Unit BRIGHTPICK, the first fully automated fulfillment solution for warehouses and grocers and added to its broad competences and industries served. In early 2025 the sensor/3D vision part of the company (‘’Photoneo’’) was acquired by Zebra Technologies, marking a significant and celebrated tech acquisition in Slovak history. We, the remaining part of the company, were rebranded as Brightpick, with hubs in the USA and EU (with main HQ in Slovakia), dedicated to providing global automation solutions for e-commerce and grocery fulfillment. Being a part of Brightpick means being a part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries further and creates space for solutions of the future. Join us and experience the journey with us! Strategická exekúcia (The Player): Prevezmeš zodpovednosť za End-to-End doručenie najdôležitejších projektov. Od prvotného kickoffu, cez alokáciu zdrojov, až po finálny release a vyhodnotenie dopadu. Náš tím umelej inteligencie zahŕňa odborníkov s rôznou úrovňou skúseností, od študentov pracujúcich popri štúdiu, cez čerstvých absolventov až po skúsenejších kolegov s dlhoročnou praxou. Úzko spolupracujeme s obchodnými oddeleniami, aby sme správne pochopili ich potreby a zabezpečili súlad s celkovou stratégiou. Z hľadiska integrácie sa radíme s architektmi. Ako tím sa pravidelne stretávame, aby sme zdieľali svoje skúsenosti a nové poznatky v oblasti strojového učenia a umelej inteligencie. Radi sa vzdelávame a navštevujeme odborné konferencie, aby sme rozšírili svoje vedomosti. Čo Vás u nás čaká? Zabezpečujete realizáciu strategických dátových projektov a projektov umelej inteligencie. Definujete dlhodobú stratégiu dátovej vedy v súlade s cieľmi organizácie a identifikujete príležitosti na využitie dát. Operatívne riadite tím dátových vedcov a zodpovedáte za ich rozvoj. Dohliadate a zavádzate štandardy pre vývoj (SLDC). Monitorujete trendy v oblasti AI, ML a dátovej analytiky a implementujete relevantné technológie. Predkladáte technické riešenia do zrozumiteľnej hodnoty pre biznis a reportujete výsledky vedeniu. Zabezpečujete efektívnu komunikáciu medzi dátovým tímom a stakeholdermi, koordinujete požiadavky biznisu a podporujete business development. Zodpovedáte za vzdelávanie zamestnancov spoločnosti v oblasti umelej inteligencie. Každý zamestnanec si môže zvoliť, či chce pracovať v štandardnom režime 50 % home office a 50 % office. Ak niektorý z kolegov uprednostňuje pracovať viac z home officu, povaha práce mu to dovoľuje a jeho nadriadený mu to schváli, môže pracovať aj v režime 60/40, 70/30 alebo 80/20 alebo dokonca aj 100 % home office. Nie sme korporát a ani malá firma – sme niečo medzi :-). Máme tu rozbehnutých veľa dlhodobých projektov, ktoré naši kolegovia úspešne zastrešujú na svojich komplexných pozíciách. Väčšina našich projektov vzniká na „zelenej lúke“ a sami sa môžete presvedčiť, aký sme v nich úspešní. Stereotyp a nuda Vám zaručene nehrozí. Úzka spolupráca s developmentom: Budeš pravou rukou Product Ownera a parťákom pre vývojárov. Tvojou úlohou je zabezpečiť, aby to, čo navrhneš vo Figme, bolo realizovateľné a funkčné v produkcii (Jira je náš kamoš). Zmysel pre detail: Máš "pixel-perfect" oko, no nezabúdaš na celkový obraz/big picture. Portfólio: Pošli nám ukážky prác, kde uvidíme nielen pekný vizuál, ale aj tvoj proces rozmýšľania. Profesionálny rast: Robíme na medzinárodných projektoch v stimulujúcom prostredí, kde sa navzájom inšpirujeme (Rumunsko, Švajčiarsko, Poľsko, …). description: Pretvárame informačné technológie na úžitok pre zákazníkov O nás Prečo my Pracovné ponuky Hľadáme IT analytika pre naše unikátne softvérové projekty! Na prvom stretnutí overíme mieru spoločnej kompatibility (hodnoty a očakávania z oboch strán). Na druhom stretnutí sa pozrieme na to, čo všetko vieš a ak uspeješ aj tu odchádzaš s ponukou, nad ktorou si isto nebudeš dlho lámať hlavu. Prečo pracovať práve u nás? Naším poslaním je pretváranie nových technológií na úžitok pre zákazníka. Toto poslanie sa odráža vo všetkom čo robíme. Ak máš silné hodnotové založenie ako my určite si budeme rozumieť. Do našich projektov vkladáme viac ako len svoje úsilie, a preto sú naše výstupy hodnotnejšie ako len podpísaný akcepťák. Budeme radi ak sa k nám pridáš na cestu za hľadaním optimálneho spôsobu realizácie hodnotných projektov pre našich zákazníkov. Ako fungujeme? Naše dodávky realizujeme prostredníctvom multidisciplinárnych tímov, ktoré sú schopné navrhovať, vyrábať a nasadzovať užitočné technológie u našich zákazníkov. Tvojou úlohou ako analytika v tomto tíme bude na základe komunikácie so zákazníkom a štúdia príslušných dokumentov mapovať procesy, zisťovať požiadavky a navrhovať informačný systém na podporu dohodnutých procesov. Ceníme si ľudí, ktorí rozumejú nielen tomu ako, ale aj tomu, čo dodávajú. Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí sú lojálni svojmu tímu a nepoznajú frázu „ja mám hotové“. Pri dodávkach si pomáhame SCRUM frameworkom, vďaka ktorému sa vieme kontinuálne zlepšovať. Budeme veľmi radi, keď sa zapojíš do jednej z mnohých rozbehnutých iniciatív tímového zlepšovania, komunitného vzdelávania či zdieľania znalostí prostredníctvom interných konferencií a workshopov. Chcete se podílet na efektivním a plně digitalizovaném řešení? Nabízíme se možnost stát se základním pilířem v cílovém řešení. Co u nás budete dělat? Bakalářské vzdělání (technické, strojírenské) Znalost AJ (úroveň B2) pro denní komunikaci se zahraničními kolegy a dodavateli, i některé naše interní schůzky jsou v AJ/NJ CJ - úroveň C2 (mateřský jazyk) Solidní porozumění technologiím webových služeb, API a HTTP protokolu včetně jejich definice Mít orientaci v integračních vzorech Výhodou je základní znalost zabezpečení REST a povědomí o certifikačních procesech Odbornou praxi: 1-2 roky v oboru Co od nás můžete získat? Chcete občas pracovat z domova? Není problém, s nadřízeným se vždy domluvíte. Projektové metodiky, technické a technologické standardy a další dovednosti v automotive oblasti získáte formou vzdělávacích kurzů a školení. Své jazykové dovednosti si rozšíříte jak formou jazykových kurzů, tak každodenním použitím při komunikaci s kolegy a dodavateli ze zahraničí. Kanceláře, ve kterých se budete cítit opravdu dobře. Vývojová centra, která nabízejí nejnovější technologie pro práci. Volnější pracovní dobu. Pracujeme 7,5 hodin denně. Pevně určený čas je od 9.00 – 14.00. Pak už je jen na vás, jestli si raději přivstanete, nebo budete pracovat déle do odpoledne. Nabízíme možnost dlouhodobě vycestovat do zahraničí (1–2 roky), a to i s celou rodinou. Získejte nové životní i pracovní zkušenosti mimo Českou republiku. Chcete se zdokonalit v projektovém řízení, osvojit si nové manažerské schopnosti nebo vypilovat cizí jazyk. Máme pro vás školení, která vám v tom pomohou. Co vám bude dělat radost? Každý rok na vás čeká 13. mzda, jako poděkování za vaši dobrou práci. Vyplácíme každoroční bonus na základě hospodářských výsledků společnosti. Protože když se daří nám, chceme, aby se dařilo i vám. Přispějeme vám na penzijní připojištění částkou 1900,- měsíčně. Nemyslíme jen na budoucnost vozů Škoda, ale i vaší rodiny. Při narození dítěte vám vyplatíme částkou 10.000,-. Vážíme si věrnosti a věříme v dlouhodobou spolupráci. Každých pět let dostanete speciální odměnu za věrnost (1.000,- za každý odpracovaný rok). 5. týden dovolené navíc. Jestli pojedete k moři nebo na hory je už na vás. Na dovolenou vám dáme nejen volno, ale i finanční příspěvek. Při využití služeb našich partnerů budete mít nárok na příspěvek 2900 Kč na dospělou osobu / 1500 Kč na dítě. Volné dny pro zvláštní příležitosti – svatba, stěhování, narození dítěte. Jsou chvíle, kdy práce může jít prostě stranou. Sodexo karta, kterou můžete využít pro zpestření volného času. Dopřejte si lístky do divadla, běžte si zasportovat nebo si užijte relax v sauně/wellnessu. Možností je opravdu hodně. Vyberte si jídlo v naší restauraci od 40 Kč, máme výběr až 10 jídel každý den, nápoj zdarma. Skriptovanie a automatizácia (Bash/Python; výhodou TypeScript), CI/CD (GitLab pipelines a GitHub Actions). Monitoring & logovanie (Zabbix, Kibana, Grafana, Graylog). Certifikácia GCP (Cloud Engineer/ Cloud Developer) a/alebo AWS (Developer/CloudOps/DevOps). Ako bude vyzerať tvoj štart: Po 1. mesiaci: poznáš naše zdieľané repozitáre, monitoring a prevádzku pridelených aplikácií; si v kontakte s produktovými tímami, riešiš operatívu. Po 3. mesiacoch: aktívne navrhuješ zlepšenie, zlepšuješ prevádzkové štandardy (SLO/alerting, automatizácia), pomáhaš s plánovaním migráce do AWS. Prečo k nám: Budeš pri kľúčovej transformácii – zaistení stability súčasného GCP prevádzky a následný presun do AWS. Reálny dopad: dostupnosť našich produktov (Profesia.sk, Platy.sk...a iné), bezpečnosť, náklady aj spokojnosť vývojových tímov. Vzdelávanie a rozvoj - domáce a zahraničné konferencie, interné technologické workshopy (SOLID, DDD, Javascript, OOP a iné), online kurzy. Dostaneš počítač a OS podľa tvojej preferencie (Linux alebo MacOS). 3 dni dovolenky navyše. Budete súčasťou odboru architektúry, ktorý zodpovedá za celkovú IT architektúru spoločnosti a nastavuje architektonický rámec, princípy a dlhodobé smerovanie technologického rozvoja. Ako AI Architekt/-ka budete v rámci tohto odboru zodpovedať za oblasť umelej inteligencie a jej architektonické uchopenie. Vašou úlohou bude podieľať sa na návrhu AI architektúr tak, aby zapadali do celkovej architektúry spoločnosti. Súčasťou práce bude aj zavádzanie štandardov, postupov a best practices v oblasti umelej inteligencie. Zapojíte sa do reálnych projektov, kde získate prehľad o prepojení technológií, dát a biznisových potrieb. Tím kladie dôraz na spoluprácu, zdieľanie znalostí a kontinuálne vzdelávanie. Hľadáme aktívneho človeka s nadšením pre inovácie a AI architektúru, so schopnosťou inšpirovať aj prakticky idei rozvíjať a pretaviť ich do praktického života. Získate prehľad o existujúcich systémoch, dátach a procesoch a budete sa podieľať na hľadaní vhodných AI prístupov a riešení. Postupne sa zapojíte do architektonických rozhodnutí na úrovni IT architektúry: Rozvíjať AI architektúru vo všetkých vrstvách (biznis, aplikačnú, dátovú, technologickú). Koordinovať architektonické aktivity – riadite architektonické činnosti v rámci portfólia AI  produktov, veľkých IT projektov a strategických iniciatív. Zabezpečujete konzistenciu riešení naprieč projektami a agilnými tímami. Spravovať katalóg produktov a komponentov – vediete katalóg produktov, technologické komponenty a spoločné služby využívané naprieč spoločnosťou. Očakávame, že budete aktívne sledovať trendy v oblasti AI a prinášať do tímu nové názory a inovatívne prístupy. Čo by ste mali ovládať? Navrhli a zrealizovali sme originálne projekty, zamerané na centrálne enterprise a front-office systémy a ich integráciu s existujúcimi informačnými systémami. Sme aj poradenská spoločnosť v oblasti re-inžinieringu podnikových procesov, pre platobné systémy a e-business, kde vieme ponúknuť riešenia pre front aj back-office, a často vystupujeme v úlohe systémového integrátora riešenia od viacerých dodávateľov. Chcete občas pracovat z domova? Není problém, s nadřízeným se vždy domluvíte. Projektové metodiky, technické a technologické standardy a další dovednosti v automotive oblasti získáte formou vzdělávacích kurzů a školení. Své jazykové dovednosti si rozšíříte jak formou jazykových kurzů, tak každodenním použitím při komunikaci s kolegy a dodavateli ze zahraničí. Kanceláře, ve kterých se budete cítit opravdu dobře. Vývojová centra, která nabízejí nejnovější technologie pro práci. Volnější pracovní dobu. Pracujeme 7,5 hodin denně. Pevně určený čas je od 9.00 – 14.00. Nemyslíme jen na budoucnost vozů Škoda, ale i vaší rodiny. Při narození dítěte vám vyplatíme částkou 10.000,-. Vážíme si věrnosti a věříme v dlouhodobou spolupráci. Každých pět let dostanete speciální odměnu za věrnost (1.000,- za každý odpracovaný rok). 5. týden dovolené navíc. Jestli pojedete k moři nebo na hory je už na vás. Na dovolenou vám dáme nejen volno, ale i finanční příspěvek. Při využití služeb našich partnerů budete mít nárok na příspěvek 2900 Kč na dospělou osobu / 1500 Kč na dítě. Volné dny pro zvláštní příležitosti – svatba, stěhování, narození dítěte. Jsou chvíle, kdy práce může jít prostě stranou. Sodexo karta, kterou můžete využít pro zpestření volného času. Dopřejte si lístky do divadla, běžte si zasportovat nebo si užijte relax v sauně/wellnessu. Možností je opravdu hodně. Vyberte si jídlo v naší restauraci od 40 Kč, máme výběr až 10 jídel každý den, nápoj zdarma. Vaše dobrá kondice a pevné zdraví je naší prioritou, proto máme pro naše zaměstnance k dispozici interní polikliniku. Výhodný zaměstnanecký pronájem vozu Škoda a slevu při koupi nového vozu. description: About Us Benefits Culture Jobs Senior Business Analyst Apply Now Date posted: 16.1.2026 Location: Bratislava, Slovakia Salary: From 2 650 EUR/month As a motivated employee, you should be compensated appropriately. Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Senior Business Analyst The Future Begins Here At Takeda, we are creating a future-ready organization that uses data and digital to meet the needs of patients, our people, and the planet. We need your help to make this happen. Join our new Innovation Capability Center (ICC) in Bratislava, Slovakia. In this role at our state-of-the-art center, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and create solutions that will benefit patients around the world. Become the heart of our internal innovation engine. At Takeda we unite in diversity Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive workplace, where individuals are recognized for the diverse backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continually improving workplace experience and accessibility for everyone, and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our Team. The Opportunity As a Senior Business Analyst, you will take ownership of business analysis activities of medium to high complexity, working closely with stakeholders who will rely on your expertise and judgment. You will lead the gathering, analysis and documentation of software specifications, while also delegating less complex tasks to junior colleagues and supporting their development. You will keep documentation for your assigned applications accurate and up to date, ensuring it reflects reality and supports smooth delivery. In your day-to-day work, you will partner closely with development teams, product/platform owners, QA and other key stakeholders to validate user stories, review QA results and drive high-quality outcomes for our digital solutions. Responsibilities •	Work independently on business analysis tasks of medium to high complexity, delivering outputs according to company standards. •	Gather, analyse and document software specifications and business requirements (discussions, workshops, interviews, refinement meetings). •	Decompose business needs into clear specifications and smaller blocks such as user stories and acceptance criteria. •	Maintain, update and manage documentation and analytical outputs (software specifications, data flow diagrams, components) for assigned applications/parts of software. •	Collaborate closely with development teams, product/platform owners, QA and other stakeholders (validation of user stories, QA outcomes, testing, training, support procedures). •	Work with business stakeholders to identify challenges, opportunities and use cases for digital solutions; support creation of POCs and definition of “success” criteria. •	Review and control analytical outputs within the analytical team; ensure outputs are complete, consistent, understandable and aligned with standards. •	Prepare and present analysis results and reports to the Project Manager / direct manager and other stakeholders. •	Provide continuous updates during project delivery; communicate changes, risks, issues and ambiguities in a timely manner. •	Guide and support junior members of chapter when necessary. Employee perks, benefits What Takeda Can Offer You At Takeda, you may build your career, while contributing to better people’s lives. Expect trust driven culture built around Integrity, Fairness, Honesty and Perseverance. Joining ICC will give you access to high-end technology, training and colleagues who will support your growth. Benefits Here are a few benefits our employees are enjoying at Takeda. To get a full picture of what we are offering, go to bit.ly/icc-bts-benefits - Cafeteria - Medical - High standard medical care - Bridge days - Summer Hours - Multisport Card Your application and any and all conversations that occur with the recruiter, HR, and the hiring manager as part of that application will be treated in the strictest confidence. Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position University education (Bachelor's degree) Language skills English - Upper intermediate (B2) Personality requirements and skills •	Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent work experience •	5+ years of experience in Business Analysis •	3+ years of experience in a Lean/Agile development environment •	Understanding of Salesforce Data Cloud, including data ingestion, harmonization, identity resolution, data modelling, and segmentation OR Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially journeys, audience segmentation, data extensions, and campaign logic OR Working knowledge of Veeva CRM, including  objects, field structures, and typical commercial/medical use cases. •	Familiarity with Agile tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence) •	Strong end-to-end BA skills: gathering, analysing and documenting business and system requirements •	Experience creating user stories and acceptance criteria •	Data analysis skills (SQL or SOQL), with an ability to validate data quality, troubleshoot inconsistencies, and interpret data •	Knowledge on, BPMN, UML including modelling tools •	Experience working with multiple systems and documenting data flows / system interactions •	Highly organized; able to break down complex problems and set priorities •	Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills •	Excellent written and verbal communication skills across all levels of the organization Nice to have requirements •	Certification in business analysis area (CBAP, BCS, other) •	Life Science/Healthcare/pharmaceutical industry background preferred. •	Familiarity / working knowledge of: Databricks, Power BI, AWS, FTP/sFTP Advertiser Brief description of the company Takeda is an industry-leading, global pharmaceutical company with an unwavering dedication to putting patients at the center of everything we do. We live our values of Takeda-ism – Integrity, Fairness, Honesty, and Perseverance – and are united by our mission to strive towards Better Health and a Brighter Future for people worldwide through leading innovation in medicine. Here, everyone matters and you will be a vital contributor to our inspiring, bold mission. At Takeda, you will make an impact on people’s lives – including your own. Takeda is an equal opportunity employer. We are taking a giant step forward to create a future-ready organization that evolves at the speed of science and technology, to meet the needs of patients by seeking and incorporating novel digital capabilities, data, and agile methodologies. Our aim is to provide digital solutions that are personalized to each patient’s unique needs and health circumstances. With individual care at the center, we can support patients in actively managing their personal care journey – from the moment they are diagnosed through treatment and beyond. Preto od Vás potrebujeme aby ste zabezpečili, že dizajny projektov sú v ich súlade a že vysvetlíte a poučíte spolupracovníkov ako sú tieto kontroly implementované. Zároveň pre zverené aplikácie budete zabezpečovať ich administráciu a prevádzku na L2 (24/7) úrovni prevádzkovaných na PaaS a IaaS, vrátane správy a konfigurácie aplikačnej vrstvy. Nemáte zároveň problém prekročiť rámec svojich zodpovedností ak si to situácia vyžaduje, chápať súvislosti v širšom kontexte a riešiť úlohy a problémy e2e (od začiatku do konca). Rozmýšľate koncepčne a máte solídne analytické schopnosti. Vyhľadávate kreatívne riešenia, ktoré spĺňajú požiadavky a garantujú kontinuitu existujúcich procesov a systémov. Participuj aj na úspechoch banky, cez zamestnanecký program sa staneš akcionárom, akcionárkou skupiny ERSTE. Chceme spolupracovať s ľuďmi, s ktorými rád/rada tráviš čas. Dáta, analýzy a reporty sú jeho kľúčovou súčasťou. Tvojou úlohou bude analyzovať dáta z webu a marketingových kampaní a premieňať ich na jasné odporúčania, ktoré pomôžu zlepšiť výsledky. Budeš pripravovať prehľadné analýzy, reporty a dashboardy. Budeš prepájať webové dáta s business dátami, aby si ukázal celkový obraz toho, ako sa nám darí. Samozrejme, na základe výsledkov budeš navrhovať odporúčania ďalších krokov. Tvoja zodpovednosť bude najmä: Poznať a navrhovať rozvoj analýz a dát potrebných pre optimalizáciu digitálneho marketingu. Rozvíjať reporting & dashboarding v kontexte priorít a KPIs. Vytvárať a interpretovať ad-hoc analýzy, podporovať A/B testing a evidence-based marketing. Ideálny/a kandidát/ka: Skúsenosti ako dátový/webový analytik, ideálne v prostredí sales alebo marketingu, vo finančnej inštitúcii, telekomunikáciách, alebo e-Commerce. Praktické skúsenosti s SQL dotazmi a databázami. Znalosť Keboola, BigQuery alebo iných nástrojov ETL/ELT je výhodou (ale nie podmienkou). Znalosť Power BI, Looker Studio, alebo podobných BI nástrojov. Všeobecný prehľad o Google Tag Manager a Google Analytics 4. Všeobecný prehľad v reklamných platformách (Meta Ads, Google Ads, Bing Ads) a ich dátových štruktúrach. Neprekvapí ťa, že vo veľkej banke nájdeš väčšiu komplexitu dát a procesov a tiež, že bezpečnosť dát berieme naozaj vážne. Si samostatný/á a máš zmysel pre vlastníctvo úloh a dát. Cítiš sa pohodlne pri podávaní správ rôznym zainteresovaným stranám, vieš vysvetliť nielen to, ako si navrhol analýzu - ale aj to, aký je výsledok. Si tímový hráč a vieš, že táto veta nie je len klišé :). Tvoje miesto u nás ti sadne. A nielen pre toto: Poď s nami dokončovať to, čo sme načali a my ťa odmeníme: Tvoju prácu u nás si vážime. Odmeníme ťa 13. platom a ročným bonusom. Extra money za úsilie navyše. Na kvalitné jedlo ti prispejeme 8€. Stravné hradíme v plnom rozsahu, a to aj v dňoch keď dovolenkuješ. Participuj aj na úspechoch banky, cez zamestnanecký program sa staneš akcionárom, akcionárkou skupiny ERSTE. Chceme spolupracovať s ľuďmi, s ktorými rád/rada tráviš čas. Odporuč nám nových kolegov a kolegyne, a my ťa odmeníme sumou až do 1000€. Urob si radosť, prispejeme ti na ňu 264€ ročne. Na to, aby si bol/a na dôchodku finančne fit Ti prispejeme do III. piliera až 840€ ročne. Pre lepšie vyváženie práce a súkromia alebo, aby si stihol/la dokončiť načaté aj doma: Dovolenkuj s nami až o 5 dní navyše. Voľný deň - pre rodiča budúceho prváčika pri jeho/jej prvom školskom dni, pri darovaní krvi, pri nadštandardnej zdravotnej prehliadke. Ťažkosti súkromné aj pracovné môžeš riešiť cez psychologickú podporu, prostredníctvom linky pomoci pre našich zamestnancov. Veríme, že v zdravom tele je zdravý duch, športuj s Multisport aj UpBalansea kartou. Zdravotný stav teba a tvojich blízkych ťa vďaka nám nezaskočí – využiť môžeš našu digitálnu ordináciu, ktorá ti je k dispozícií doma aj v zahraničí Vzdelávaj sa a dokončuj svoje štúdia, veríme, že ti v tom pomôžu workshopy, ktoré pripravujeme spolu s platformou SEDUO. Electronics & Embedded Systems Engineer Place of work Plynárenská 4937/6, Ružinov Contract type full-time Wage (gross) 2 400 EUR/month Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Brightpick is revolutionizing warehouse automation with cutting-edge robotic solutions and intelligent systems that power some of the world’s most advanced fulfillment centers. We design and deliver technology that helps customers achieve operational excellence with speed, precision, and reliability. We are looking for a creative and hands-on Electronics & Embedded Systems Engineer to join our Mechatronics team. You will work alongside smart colleagues to design the "brain and nervous system" of our Autonomous Mobile Robots and complex automation machinery. The Role As an Electronics & Embedded Systems Engineer, you will bridge the gap between mechanical hardware and intelligent software. Your primary goal is to design, prototype, and implement electronic components and integrated circuits that drive our automation solutions. You will handle the full spectrum of electronics engineering—from designing circuits and building rough "proof-of-concept" prototypes to developing low-level embedded software and finalizing instructions for mass production. This role requires a deep understanding of servo drives, sensors, and the communication protocols that make industrial automation tick. Location Bratislava Type of employment Full-time Salary (brutto) From € 2400/month based on seniority and experience Core responsibilities: Execute functional and technical design of electronic components, PCBs, and integrated circuits for robotics and industrial automation. Develop low-level embedded software and firmware, ensuring robust communication between subsystems. Build and test functional prototypes to validate concepts quickly; diagnostics and functionality are prioritized over aesthetics during the prototyping phase. Prepare systems for mass production, creating comprehensive manufacturing instructions and documentation to ensure scalability. Integrate servo drives and automation sensors, defining control logic and ensuring precise actuation and data feedback. Design and maintain software development processes, ensuring code quality, version control, and reliability. Manage technical governance, overseeing safety certifications and ensuring designs meet industrial compliance standards. Collaborate on multiple projects simultaneously, working closely with the Mechatronics Team Leader to meet departmental deadlines. Support onsite deployment (approx. 10% travel), assisting with the installation and commissioning of technology at customer locations Requirements: Master’s degree (M.Sc.) in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field. Solid real-life experience with Low-Level and Embedded Programming (C/C++). Deep knowledge of low-level communication protocols (I2C, SPI, RS-232, RS-485); knowledge of Ethernet TCP/IP is a strong advantage. Proven capability in designing electrical circuits and diagnosing electronic components. Strong practical understanding of servo drives and automation sensors. Ability to prioritize functionality and problem-solving over perfectionism during the prototyping phase. PLC programming experience is considered a significant advantage. Active professional English language skills (B2 or higher) for documentation and technical collaboration, and fluent Slovak language Benefits: Daily breakfast in the office Option of working from home/hybrid work (in case the position allows it) Flexible work schedule (in case the position allows it) Sick days Parking for everyone, bike storage with showers and changing rooms on site at our HQ Rooftop terrace with nice view of Bratislava Dog friendly office Multisport Card Referral program Additional benefits you can choose from after 1st year: Multisport Card (with company contribution) Contribution to a recreation stay Year-round healthcare access at ProCare Supplementary pension contribution (III pilier) Brain boost - budget for professional development Annual public transportation pass E-Shop voucher to buy anything you might need Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position Secondary with school-leaving examination Language skills English - Upper intermediate (B2) and Slovak - Proficiency (C2) Advertiser Brief description of the company The journey of our company started in 2013 when 4 friends came up with the idea to provide eyes for robots worldwide so that they could see and understand it. This idea led to a series of patents and awards. Shortly thereafter, the four-man company grew fast, becoming a technological sanctuary for machine vision, smart automation enthusiasts & innovators. In 2021 Photoneo launched its new Business Unit BRIGHTPICK, the first fully automated fulfillment solution for warehouses and grocers and added to its broad competences and industries served. In early 2025 the sensor/3D vision part of the company (‘’Photoneo’’) was acquired by Zebra Technologies, marking a significant and celebrated tech acquisition in Slovak history. We, the remaining part of the company, were rebranded as Brightpick, with hubs in the USA and EU (with main HQ in Slovakia), dedicated to providing global automation solutions for e-commerce and grocery fulfillment. Being a part of Brightpick means being a part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries further and creates space for solutions of the future. Join us and experience the journey with us! LIS), audit dátovej kvality a školiace aktivity pre tím. title: Hľadáme Teamleadra pre agilné ICT tímy – digitálne kanály (m/ž)
description: Prehrať video Voľné pozície Hľadáme Teamleadra pre agilné ICT tímy – digitálne kanály (m/ž) Bratislava, Slovensko (Pozícia umožňuje občasnú prácu z domu) 3 500 EUR/mesiac plný úväzok Aký bude pracovný deň u nás? Naše mobilné aplikácie a digitálne služby posúvame na úplne novú úroveň. A na to hľadáme lídra , ktorý dokáže prepájať technológie, ľudí a biznis tak, aby vznikali riešenia, ktoré majú skutočný dopad. Ako teamleader budete viesť viacero agilných tímov, ktoré vyvíjajú a prevádzkujú naše mobilné aplikácie. Budete mať priestor ovplyvniť smerovanie digitálnych riešení, ktoré používajú státisíce klientov – a urobiť to spôsobom, ktorý je efektívny, udržateľný a technologicky moderný. Čo Vás čaká? riadenie end-to-end dodávok v spolupráci s produktovými vlastníkmi, projektovými manažérmi a architektmi, plánovanie kapacít, rozpočtov a priorít podľa digitálnej stratégie banky, podpora tímov tak, aby dokázali rýchlo a kvalitne doručovať, koordinácia biznis požiadaviek, analýzy, návrhu riešení a implementácie, komunikácia so stakeholdermi a prezentácia výsledkov manažmentu. Čo budete tvoriť? digitálne riešenia, ktoré denne používajú naši klienti, prostredie, kde môžu Vaši ľudia rásť a podávať kvalitnú prácu, fungujúce procesy, ktoré podporujú rýchlu a bezpečnú dodávku, riešenia, ktoré sú škálovateľné, moderné a pripravené na budúcnosť. Prečo sa k nám pridať? budete viesť dôležité produktové tímy v oblasti, ktorá je pre banku strategická, dostanete priestor prinášať nové nápady a reálne ich uviesť do praxe, budete spolupracovať s odborníkmi z rôznych oblastí, čaká Vás stabilné prostredie, hybridná práca a možnosti rastu. Poslať životopis Koho hľadáme? Hľadáme človeka, ktorý: má skúsenosti s IT projektami a vývojom softvéru (5+ rokov), rozumie agilnému fungovaniu (Scrum, Kanban), vie prepájať technické a biznis hľadisko, má skúsenosti s vedením projektov, tímov alebo dodávateľov, dokáže rýchlo pochopiť problém a efektívne ho premeniť na plán, vie komunikovať jasne, vecne a s rešpektom, výhodou je skúsenosť z finančného sektora, s integračnými riešeniami a bezpečnostnými témami (autentifikácia, autorizácia). Riešiš IT incidenty a požiadavky interných používateľov – od  softvéru, prístupových práv až po O365, SAP a interné aplikácie DPD. Zabezpečíš prvotnú diagnostiku, vyriešiš problém alebo ho správne nasmeruješ na vyššiu úroveň podpory. Budeš riadiť komunikáciu v pridelených incidentoch a úzko spolupracovať s klientmi či partnermi pri analýze nedostatkov. Postaráš sa o správu používateľských účtov a oprávnení (Active Directory, interné aplikácie) a overíš funkčnosť vybavených požiadaviek. Budeš monitorovať a podporovať prevádzku IT systémov (Grafana, Zabbix), riešiť problémy a eskalovať ich dodávateľom alebo vyššej podpore. Získaš zodpovednosť za administráciu a správu Jira Service Managementu – projekty, workflowy, SLA, automatizácie, oprávnenia, reporting, prepojenie s Confluence. Vytvoríš a budeš udržiavať znalostnú databázu, návody a dokumentáciu, aby si pomohol používateľom aj kolegom. Budeš spolupracovať s technickými tímami pri riešení výpadkov a incidentov, komunikovať so zákazníkmi, partnermi a dodávateľmi. Pripravíš pravidelné IT reporty a budeš automatizovať procesy (Python, Excel). Podporíš projekty pri nasadzovaní nových aplikácií a riešení – testovanie, školenia používateľov, konzultačná činnosť v oblasti systémov DPD. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract. Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties Are you a technology fan and impressed by aircrafts and ships or are you fascinated by nature and agriculture? Do you want to be part of the energy transition to renewables, or do you see yourself as the Cyber guardian? If your response is yes, continue to read our job offer. We are working on all these products and are growing our team! About the role •	Develop and implement Proof of Concepts, Minimum Viable Products/Pilots and operational solutions for the building blocks of Specialty Digital projects (eg. Contracts, reporting, accounting, claims and costing tools) •	Work and collaborate with developer teams inside and outside of SwissRe •	Use best practices in Software Engineering and Operations. •	Work closely with UX, product, architecture and engineering teams in delivering solutions. •	Do hands-on software development in the relevant coding languages About the team and the project If tackling complex challenges in a wide range of industries excites you, then join our innovative team, where you are at the forefront of creating new ingenious solutions in a collaborative way. Our team is an empowered tech counterpart for our business units, responsible for the design and implementation of inventive data and software projects. We develop new analytics and software tools and improve Swiss Re's risk assessment capabilities. Joining us, you will learn not only how insurance premiums are modelled and how data and technology can enrich business but also the technologies that are used in modern SaaS applications and in an internal system landscape with a focus on cloud technology and distributed systems. You will be the one responsible for enabling our business to live up to the aspirations and therefore you will contribute significantly to the success of the company. Employee perks, benefits You can look forward to extra rewards and benefits including: - Attractive performance-based bonus - Ultra flexible working time in hybrid setup, allowing you to work also from home - Modern office spaces in attractive location - 5 additional days of holiday - Lunch allowance fully paid by Swiss Re - Referral bonus - Pension & risk insurance contribution - Sick days and sick leave support - Public transport benefit - Multisport card Information about the selection process We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. Our aim is to live visible and invisible diversity – diversity of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, physical abilities, personalities and experiences – at all levels and in all functions and regions. We also collaborate in a flexible working environment, providing you with a compelling degree of autonomy to decide how, when and where to carry out your tasks. We provide feedback to all candidates via email. If you have not heard back from us, please check your spam folder. Requirements for the employee Candidates with education suit the position University education (Bachelor's degree) University education (Master's degree) Postgraduate (Doctorate) Language skills English - Upper intermediate (B2) Personality requirements and skills Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are genuinely curious about the world of software development, we will be happy to meet you. We are looking for enthusiastic individuals who can be effective leaders with functional and operational expertise. You must be a good communicator who builds trust-based relationships within the squad and amongst partners. If you possess traits and experience that match most of the below, we’d love to hear from you: Must have: •	Bachelor or Master's degree in quantitative science (data, computer, engineering) •	Experience in software development following agile delivery concepts (e.g. SCRUM and Kanban) •	Hands-on coding knowledge in at least one of C#, Typescript/Angular, Python or Go is essential. •	Team-player with credibility and working style to build positive relationships and support an open feedback culture. •	Able to balance multiple projects in parallel, exchange with senior partners and build consensus. •	Able to communicate sophisticated concepts in a compelling, concise, and simple way, with good (written and verbal) interpersonal skills in English and ability to work independently and proactively. Nice to have: •	Experience with Cloud-Native solution architecture / design pattern and platforms (e.g. AKS, App Service on Azure, Docker, Frontend/Micro-Frontend / BFF-Backend for Frontend / Microservice Architecture with RESTful APIs, event-based/message-based architecture, Azure Data Services such as Data Factory, Data Lake, Synapse Analytics and other products; DevOps with Terraform, Application Insights and other PaaS features on Azure; Security with OAuth/OIDC, Okta, AAD, Cloudflare WAF, .NET Framework) is a strong plus •	You have strong entrepreneurial spirit, showing high degree of own initiative, pragmatism and result focus. •	Insurtech experience is a strong plus. •	You have a sound background in data analytics, demonstrate strong analytical skills and can focus on details without losing track of the bigger picture •	Knowledge of (facultative/direct insurance) underwriting is a plus. •	Strong desire to work in virtual, multi-national, multi-cultural, cross-company and cross-functional teams, and to be mobile in terms of workplace or location if required. Ak máš skúsenosti s prostredím Microsoft 365 a chceš sa podieľať na správe technológií, ktoré slúžia verejnému záujmu, si na správnom mieste. Ako zapadneš do nášho M365 ekosystému? ​ Budeš správcom M365 sveta – od Exchange Online až po Azure AD/Entra ID. Tvoja misia: zabezpečiť, aby všetko fungovalo ako hodinky; Pomôžeš organizáciám “zbaliť kufre” a presťahovať sa do nášho spoločného M365 tenantu – bez stresu a s dobrou náladou; Navrhneš migračné plány aj pre tie organizácie, ktoré zatiaľ "bývajú samy" (nemajú vlastný tenant); Presunieš e-maily, súbory a identity do nového domova – čo najhladšie, aby si to koncoví používatelia ani nevšimli; Postaráš sa o poriadok v licenciách Microsoft 365 – žiadne nevyužité miesta ani zbytočné výdavky; Nastavíš bezpečnostné politiky, ktoré budú v súlade s internými pravidlami aj overenými postupmi. Bezpečnosť je totiž základ; Pomôžeš budovať znalostnú bázu a udržiavať dokumentáciu – aby si ďalší vedeli, ako na to; Podporíš a mentoruješ náš L1 tím – nech technické výzvy zvládame spoločne; Budeš pri návrhoch a realizácii prepojení s inými aplikáciami – pretože integrácia je základ moderného IT; Budeš sledovať a riešiť problémy v M365 – preventívne aj operatívne. Niekedy ako detektív, inokedy ako hasič; Samozrejme po celý čas budeš spolupracovať s kolegami a v prípade potreby aj dodávateľmi – pretože aj superhrdina M365 niekedy potrebuje tím. Čo by si mal/a mať so sebou? Skúsenosti s migráciou do Microsoft 365 – najmä Exchange Online, SharePoint Online či Teams; Dobré technické zázemie v administrácii Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) a znalosť Microsoft 365 služieb ako Exchange Online, Teams a SharePoint; Prehľad a prax v správe licencií M365 – vieš, kto čo potrebuje a nič ti neunikne; Pokročilé znalosti PowerShellu – nemusíš byť hneď mág, ale ak vieš niečo vyčarovať zo skriptov, určite to oceníme; Základné povedomie o informačnej bezpečnosti a ITIL procesoch – aspoň orientačne, zvyšok doladíme spolu; Zamestnanecké výhody, benefity Na čo sa u nás môžeš tešiť: ​Flexibilný pracovný čas Možnosť pracovať z domu 2 dni v týždni Zvýšený výmer dovolenky o 1 týždeň nad rámec zákona 2 dni v roku voľno na regeneráciu navyše Príspevok na DDS Teambuildingové aktivity Vzdelávanie zamestnancov Informácie o výberovom konaní Ak ťa naša vízia zaujala, neváhaj nám zaslať životopis a motivačný list. company: Deutsche Telekom Services Europe Slovakia s.r.o.
description: Deutsche Telekom Services Europe Slovakia O nás Voľné pozície Firemná kultúra Benefity Kontakt Technical Digital Product Manager – People Development End2End Experience At Deutsche Telekom, we believe that investing in employee development is key to unlocking the full potential of our organization. As part of HR Headquarters, our team is responsible for global products concerning People Development within Deutsche Telekom AG. By developing a variety of internal HR products and offers like learning & development, skills intelligence or engagement surveys, we make Deutsche Telekom the best place to develop and grow. Contract type full-time Place of work Košice, Slovak Republic Start date ASAP Wage (gross) From 2 700 EUR/month About the position We are looking for a Digital Product Manager to connect our various people development products into a holistic end-to-end user experience. To achieve this, we are looking to improve existing products, further integrate existing products, but also potentially build new custom experience solutions that bring things together. You will be responsible for the design of our people development information in our new internal content/news platform. We are also investing in bringing our processes into the flow of work. The vision is that our employees get course recommendations via a Microsoft Teams chat instead of navigating to our Learning Experience Platform. This role is focused on product management, digital adoption, and project coordination. It’s a hands-on role, where you will be able to shape the technical design of this future experience yourself. Previous experience with developing custom solutions is a real benefit. You will be working with your dedicated team, as well as the various existing product teams. If we go the custom solutions route, you will be provided with software development capacity, which you will then steer directly. Your tasks: Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for end-to-end people development experience Gather and refine functional and non-functional requirements with business stakeholders. Translate user needs into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications. Lead end-to-end delivery of custom software solutions—from concept to deployment and post-launch optimization. Maintain clear product backlog management, sprint planning, and release alignment with development teams. Closely collaborate with existing product teams, designing how their product fits the end-to-end experience We work in a HYBRID STYLE of working. The published salary is the minimum possible offer. The starting salary may be higher depending on the extent of fulfillment of the employee's requirements (education, language skills, required practice, personality assumptions and skills). What we expect Candidates with education suit the position University education (Master's degree) Language skills English - Advanced (C1) Personality requirements and skills You have a completed university degree and already have a minimum of 4 years of professional experience. Furthermore, you distinguish yourself through the following knowledge and skills: Experience in Digital Product Management: We’re looking for someone with digital product management experience, ideally within SaaS, platform implementation, or HR technologies. Strong Project Management Skills: Proven track record in managing cross-functional teams, technical rollouts, and global platform implementations. Experience with agile methodologies is a plus. Experience managing custom IT solutions with dev teams is really helpful. Data-Driven & Analytical: Experience with usage analytics, A/B testing, and user engagement metrics. A keen eye for data-driven improvements and prioritization. Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business leaders, and vendors, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned on goals and progress. Familiarity with Change Management: While this is not a traditional role, experience in change management or driving organizational adoption of new technologies will be crucial. Your English is on the highest level. You are flexible to travel. Information about the position Job description, responsibilities and duties About the role At Swiss Re, our mission is to make the world more resilient by helping society understand, manage, and transfer risk. In the Specialty reinsurance business, this mission takes a very concrete form: Swiss Re supports the coverage of complex, high-severity risks such as aviation, marine, energy, cyber, and political risk – expo-sures that are essential to global trade, infrastructure, and economic stability, yet difficult or impossible to carry without reinsurance. As Lead Specialty Architect, you play a key role in enabling this business through technology. By shaping, evolving, and safeguarding the application landscape that supports Specialty underwriting and client engage-ment, you help ensure that these risks can be assessed, managed, and transferred reliably and at scale. In doing so, your work contributes directly to the stability and effectiveness of Swiss Re’s Specialty business and, ultimately, to the resilience of the systems and industries it supports. Key responsibilities As Lead Specialty Architect, you are the architectural owner of the Specialty application landscape within P&C Re, with end-to-end accountability across all the architectural disciplines: •	Own the application and technical architecture for all Specialty business applications, covering their full lifecycle from design to operations. •	Oversee the development, maintenance, and evolution of both internal underwriting applications and externally facing solutions used by Swiss Re’s Specialty reinsurance clients. •	Shape the Specialty business application landscape in close collaboration with Business Architecture, ensuring clear domain alignment and long-term sustainability. •	Design and evolve the Specialty data architecture together with P&C Re Data Architecture, including data models, integration patterns, and analytical foundations. •	Define and govern cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, ensuring scalability, security, cost efficiency, and operational robustness. •	Ensure operational stability and resilience of the application portfolio by working closely with the central Level-2 support team and the Reliability & Resilience Architecture function. •	Actively contribute to the P&C Re Architecture chapter, helping define standards, reference architec-tures, and application blueprints. •	Own and lead one or two cross-cutting architectural topics relevant across all P&C Re IT product are-as. •	Foster strong, trust-based collaboration between application development teams and the Architec-ture function. Why this role matters This is a role for someone who wants real impact. The decisions you make will influence how Specialty reinsur-ance is underwritten, managed, and scaled at Swiss Re – and, by extension, how complex global risks are ab-sorbed and mitigated. If you are looking for an architect role with genuine ownership, strategic relevance, and a direct connection to Swiss Re’s purpose, we would be pleased to hear from you. Employee perks, benefits You can look forward to extra rewards and benefits including: - Attractive performance-based bonus - Ultra flexible working time in hybrid setup, allowing you to work also from home - Modern office spaces in attractive location - 5 additional days of holiday - Lunch allowance fully paid by Swiss Re - Referral bonus - Pension & risk insurance contribution - Sick days and sick leave support - Public transport benefit - Multisport card Information about the selection process We are an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. Our aim is to live visible and invisible diversity – diversity of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, physical abilities, personalities and experiences – at all levels and in all functions and regions. We also collaborate in a flexible working environment, providing you with a compelling degree of autonomy to decide how, when and where to carry out your tasks. Personal & Leadership Skills Equally important are your personal strengths: •	Strong thought leadership and influencing skills; ability to challenge the status quo and advocate for meaningful change. •	Architectural mindset, with a structured approach to problem-solving and strong planning and design capabilities. •	Proven ability to break down complex problems into manageable components and design coherent solutions. •	Exceptional ability to explain architectural decisions clearly and logically to both technical and non-technical audiences. •	High personal integrity, accountability, and a proactive approach to ownership and decision-making. •	Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to build trusted relationships across teams, functions, and geographies. •	Fluency in spoken and written English.
